jobs.description:
Job Summary

Senior Health Informatics Standards and Interoperability Consultant

Aptive is seeking a Senior Health Informatics Standards and Interoperability Consultant to support the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Health Informatics (OHI), Clinical Informatics and Data Management Office (OCI), in advancing the enterprise standard of care through standardized, semantically consistent, and reliably exchanged health data across 170+ VA Medical Centers.

This role spans both the meaning of clinical data and the movement of it. You will develop the semantic infrastructure (metadata, ontology standards, terminology tooling, and knowledge management resources) that governs how clinical concepts are represented, and you will provide expert oversight across healthcare integration standards, standards implementation, data integration, systems integration, data modeling, and data warehousing. You will serve as the formal liaison and advisor between VHA architecture and analysis teams and standards bodies such as HL7, and provide expert guidance on scientific and medical informatics domains.

Work on this program is organized under the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Semantic models, integration designs, data models, and analytical products are delivered as Features within quarterly Planning Intervals, demonstrated to the government on a two-week cadence, and tracked in Jira and Jira Align. The ideal candidate brings a decade of analysis and management experience in the health sciences, deep ontology and interoperability expertise, and the judgment to set technical direction that others will build against.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Semantic Infrastructure Development. Develop and maintain the semantic infrastructure supporting enterprise clinical data, including metadata, ontology standards, information models, reference data, and value sets used in the classification and standardization of clinical and medical data.
  • Ontology Design and Governance. Design, extend, and govern ontologies and controlled vocabularies; establish modeling conventions, hierarchies, and post-coordination rules; and evaluate ontology quality, internal consistency, and fitness for intended use.
  • Semantic Interoperability. Apply semantic interoperability concepts so clinical data can be exchanged and reused across systems without loss of meaning; develop, test, and validate mappings and crosswalks between local, national, and international code systems.
  • Knowledge Management. Build and maintain knowledge management resources such as wikis, knowledge bases, data dictionaries, modeling guides, and decision repositories so that semantic and architectural decisions remain discoverable, auditable, and reusable.
  • Healthcare Integration Standards Oversight. Provide expert oversight of healthcare integration standards across the program; establish which standards apply to which exchange scenarios, resolve conflicting interpretations, and set the technical direction that engineering and analysis teams build against.
  • Standards Implementation. Guide implementation of HL7 v2, C-CDA, FHIR, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, and CDISC; review interface specifications, conformance profiles, and implementation guides; and validate that delivered work conforms to both the standard and VHA requirements.
  • Data Integration. Direct the design and oversight of data integration across clinical, administrative, and ancillary source systems; define transformation, reconciliation, and error-handling approaches; and assess integration quality, completeness, and semantic fidelity end to end.
  • Systems Integration. Oversee integration between enterprise health systems and downstream consumers; evaluate interface engines, messaging patterns, and API strategies; and identify dependencies, failure modes, and performance constraints before they reach production.
  • Data Modeling. Lead logical and physical data modeling for health information assets; govern model conventions, keys, and lineage; and ensure models support both operational exchange and downstream analytic use without rework.
  • Data Warehousing. Provide oversight of health data warehouse design and evolution, including source-to-target mapping, dimensional and normalized modeling approaches, historization, and the controls needed to keep warehoused data trustworthy for reporting and decision support.
  • High-Level Analysis. Perform high-level analytical duties on complex informatics, integration, and information management problems; evaluate options against cost, risk, and mission impact; and produce defensible recommendations for government decision-makers.
  • Standards Body Liaison. Serve as liaison and advisor between the architecture and analysis team and standards bodies such as HL7, SNOMED International, and CDISC; track ballots, releases, and emerging specifications; represent VHA technical interests; and translate standards activity into concrete program guidance.
  • Expert Domain Guidance. Provide expert guidance on scientific and medical informatics domains to clinical subject matter experts, engineers, data architects, and governance bodies, translating technical constraints into decisions leadership can act on.
  • Leadership and Training in Health Standards. Provide leadership and training in health standards to architects, analysts, engineers, and clinical stakeholders; build reference materials and reusable guidance; and raise the standards fluency of the teams you support.
  • Feature Delivery. Translate government-provided problem statements into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and non-functional requirements for semantic, integration, modeling, and warehousing work prioritized in Planning Interval planning.
  • Agile Team Participation. Serve as the senior informatics and standards authority on interdisciplinary agile teams; participate in daily stand-ups, iteration planning, PI planning, retrospectives, roadmap updates, and biweekly demonstration ceremonies.
  • Documentation and Artifacts. Produce information models, architecture depictions, interface specifications, mapping documents, data dictionaries, and technical documentation to a standard that supports government acceptance, audit, and reuse across teams.
  • Risk, Quality, and Stakeholder Engagement. Identify, document, and track risks and issues related to data standards, terminology currency, integration, and semantic integrity; maintain risk registers; and engage stakeholders across VHACO, VISNs, VAMCs, OIT, and partner organizations to support change management for standards and integration decisions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in health or biomedical informatics, information or computer science, library and information science, a clinical discipline, or a related field.
  • 10 years of analysis and/or management experience in one or more of the disciplines associated with the health sciences.
  • Within that experience, a minimum of 5 years in ontology and semantic interoperability concepts related to clinical or medical data classification and standardization.
  • Demonstrated experience working with standards bodies or standards such as SNOMED, CDISC, HL7, and ASCO.
  • Demonstrated experience developing semantic infrastructure, including metadata, ontology standards, terminology tooling, and knowledge management resources.
  • Expert-level command of healthcare integration standards and standards implementation, including HL7 v2, C-CDA, and FHIR.
  • Demonstrated depth across data integration, systems integration, data modeling, and data warehousing sufficient to provide oversight rather than execution alone.
  • Experience performing high-level analytical duties on complex health information problems.
  • Experience serving as a liaison or advisor between technical teams and health standards bodies such as HL7.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide leadership and training in health standards to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in an Agile or Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, including backlog management and delivery tracking in Jira and/or Jira Align.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, including advanced Excel; familiarity with Power BI and the Power Platform.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to brief technical, clinical, and executive stakeholders and produce decision-quality documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple concurrent priorities, and deliver on a fixed iteration and Planning Interval cadence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Position is located within the United States; legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required.

Desired Qualifications

  • Doctoral-level degree (PhD, MD, DO, PharmD) in a health science or informatics discipline.
  • Clinical background such as physician, nurse, pharmacist, or allied health professional, with the ability to validate semantic and integration decisions against real clinical practice.
  • HL7 certification (v2.x Control Specialist, CDA Specialist, or FHIR Proficiency) or SNOMED CT certification.
  • Active participation in HL7, SNOMED International, LOINC, or CDISC work groups, ballot cycles, or connectathons.
  • Hands-on experience with terminology and ontology tooling such as Apelon DTS, Protégé, Snowstorm, Ontoserver, or TermSpace.
  • Hands-on experience with interface engines and integration platforms such as Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, or InterSystems.
  • Experience with FHIR profiling and US Core, FHIR terminology service operations, and value set authoring or publication in VSAC.
  • Experience with IHE profiles, national interoperability frameworks such as TEFCA, or health information exchange operations at scale.
  • Experience with common data models or research data standards such as OMOP, i2b2, or CDISC SDTM and CDASH.
  • Direct VA or VHA experience, including work with OHI, OCI, CPMO, EHRM, Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), or VistA/CPRS.
  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner Millennium) reference data, code sets, or interface configuration.
  • Experience with knowledge representation technologies such as RDF, OWL, and SPARQL.
  • Experience supporting data governance, master data management, or patient identity and record matching in a large health system.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical direction to informaticists, architects, and integration engineers.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. jobs.description:
About CharterUP. CharterUP is transforming the $450+ billion group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers to thousands of bus operators nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title:Client Solutions Partner

Reports to:Sales Manager

Location: Remote

About the Role

This is a hybrid inbound and outbound sales role for people who are hungry to drive revenue, build repeat business, and own their results. It rewards individuals who thrive under pressure, act decisively, and operate with high urgency and precision. You will manage hundreds of customer interactions per week, build your own book of business, and ensure every booking experience reinforces CharterUP’s reputation for speed, reliability, and excellence.

As a Client Solutions Partner (CSP), you’ll be in the thick of the action, handling high volumes of inbound demand while chasing down the next opportunity before anyone else does. You’ll be responsible for both closing new customers and expanding recurring ones, managing a mini-portfolio of high-value accounts that rely on you as their trusted CharterUP contact. We’re looking for sharp, decisive, high-judgment sales athletes who can think fast, act faster, and refuse to settle for "good enough." You’ll be part of a team that executes with urgency, precision, and accountability every single day.

Responsibilities

  • Hit and exceed every metric. Own performance against conversion rates, revenue targets, outbound and inbound activity, repeat bookings, and overall account growth.
  • Manage a high volume of inbound leads while driving outbound reactivation and expansion efforts to capture repeat and new business.
  • Leverage CharterUP’s proprietary marketplace technology to create tailored, accurate trip quotes that minimize friction in the booking process.
  • Execute disciplined call patterns to maintain conversion velocity and follow-up consistency.
  • Build urgency, rapport, and trust in every interaction, closing decisively through confident communication and assumptive sales techniques.
  • Drive repeat business by identifying high-value accounts, expanding relationships over time, and turning one-time bookings into repeat relationships.
  • Apply call control, objection handling, and active listening to diagnose customer needs and drive efficient bookings.
  • Escalate only when needed, solve problems directly, and push through roadblocks to deliver outcomes.
  • Use sound judgment and data to decide where to focus for highest yield.
  • Detect and stop low-value activity early to protect revenue through commercial acumen.
  • Maintain complete accuracy in quoting, CRM updates, and call documentation, ensuring operational precision across systems including Salesforce, Outreach, G-Suite, Slack, and proprietary tools.
  • Collaborate with peers and leadership on post-mortems and performance reviews to refine tactics and improve execution.

Experience and Expertise

  • 3+ years of experience in sales, account management, or hybrid revenue roles, consistently exceeding performance goals.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a book of business, expanding spend, deepening relationships, and driving retention.
  • Proven success balancing high-volume inbound response with targeted outbound prospecting and account development.
  • Skilled in navigating multi-contact organizations and identifying new opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Expert communicator with mastery in objection handling, urgency creation, and assumptive closing across varied customer types.
  • Proficient in CRM and sales enablement tools (Salesforce, Outreach, G-Suite, Slack), ensuring disciplined follow-up and accurate documentation.
  • Analytical and data-driven, using performance metrics and conversion insights to guide activity and optimize revenue outcomes.
  • Comfortable owning end-to-end client relationships from quote generation to post-trip follow-up, feedback, and repeat engagement.
  • History of competitive achievement or performance-based success in athletics, startups, or other quota-driven environments.

What Defines You

Core Character

  • Extreme Ownership: You don’t wait for direction; you execute the mission.
  • Grit & Hunger: You outwork, outlast, and outthink everyone around you.
  • Self-Starter Energy: You see gaps, fill them, and move before others even notice.
  • Loyalty & Integrity: You keep your word, play for the team, and own your reputation.

What We Mean by Grit

  • Relentless follow-through: You pursue a clear yes or no; you don’t let deals stall.
  • High output as a habit: You work the plan daily and maintain volume during busy seasons.
  • Resilient under pressure: You handle rejection, ambiguity, and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
  • Competitive drive: You want to be at the top of the board and treat targets as non-negotiable.
  • Bias to action: You prefer testing and iterating over waiting for perfect information.

Cognitive & Decision Traits

  • High Intellect: You process fast, connect dots, and make the right call under pressure.
  • Analytical Judgment: You use data to make decisions, not noise.
  • Decisive Execution: You don’t overthink; you move with conviction.

Recruiting Process

Step 1: 30-minute call with Talent Acquisition
Step 2: 1-hour Video Call with a Hiring Manager
Step 3: 1-hour Video Call / Role Play Interview
Step 4: 30-minute Interview with CEO
Step 5: Offer and Background Check

Welcome aboard

Salary
$63,000—$120,000 USD

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, Miami, and Denver as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer II (Employer of Record)
jobs.excerpt: Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company with workplace recognition in multiple categories!
jobs.description:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company with workplace recognition in multiple categories! Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated Team Members who share a drive to succeed as professionals and together as a company. A great product, amazing people and our stable financial history have made us one of the largest used car finance companies in the United States.


In this role, you will work as a dedicated member of a globally distributed team, partnering closely with business partners in the U.S. to design, build, and scale solutions that directly impact our customers and operations. While your legal employer will be our EoR partner, you will be fully integrated into our Credit Acceptance team for day-to-day work and collaboration.

As a Security Operations Engineer II, you'll work with the team to understand, mitigate, and respond to threats quickly, restoring operations and limiting the impact. Additionally, you will apply knowledge of attacker techniques to uncover threats by analyzing log data and researching vulnerabilities to report on and build automation. Technical expertise and the ability to transform raw data into valuable information are essential for success in this role. Additionally, you will aid in supporting the vulnerability management program and senior security engineer within the SOC.

Outcomes and Activities

Information Security

  • Operate and tune enterprise security tools (EDR, SIEM/SOAR, WAF/proxy, email security).
  • Manage proxy filtering policies, exceptions, SSL inspection, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Build automation and playbooks (Python/PowerShell, SOAR, APIs) to streamline SecOps tasks.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code workflows for consistent, auditable security configuration changes.
  • Author and tune detection rules; improve signal quality and reduce false positives.
  • Maintain and author health dashboards, uptime/coverage metrics, and change governance documentation.
  • Conduct knowledge transfers through runbooks, how-to guides, tabletop exercises, and lunch & learn training sessions.
  • Maintain upgrade schedules, license compliance, configuration baselines, and key/secret rotations.
  • Administer URL/category policies, SSL inspection, identity-aware policies, geo/risk-based controls, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Analyze block events for false positives; measure impact; retire exceptions on schedule and report residual risk.
  • Build and maintain an automation backlog in partnership with SecOps, prioritizing high-frequency, high-toil tasks.
  • Provide on-call support for tooling availability and ingestion/normalization issues.
  • Report on metrics (uptime, coverage, MTTR, lead time, change success rate, exception aging).
  • Keep documentation, diagrams, and asset inventories current.
  • As needed, monitor and respond to alerts raised by various toolsets as part of an ongoing 24/7 Security Operations Center.
  • Report outages or incidents following guidelines and procedures.
  • Detect, analyze, and respond to incidents, coordinate with other stakeholders for containing, eradicating, and recovering from an incident.
  • Assist in developing testing criteria to implement new signatures/rules.

Other

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Remains compliant with our policies, processes and legal guidelines.
  • Works remotely.

Competencies:

  • Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
  • Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
  • One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
  • Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Science or closely related field of study or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in cyber security, anomaly detection, Security Operations Center (SOC) detection, threat analytics, security incident and event management (SIEM), information technology (IT), operations incident response, network security or security engineering
  • Basic experience administering, deploying and managing security tools.
  • Basic experience operating WAF/proxy and SIEM/SOAR.
  • Scripting in Python and/or PowerShell and building API integrations; JSON/YAML proficiency.
  • CI/CD and Git workflows; Infrastructure-as-Code for security configurations.
  • Basic understanding of TLS/SSL, HTTP, identity-aware policies, and egress/ingress routing.
  • Documentation discipline and change management (ITIL basics).
  • Ability to produce formal and informal reports, briefings, and analysis of security controls.
  • Experience with Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) or Intrusion Detection System or Intrusion Prevention System (IDS/IPS) monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK Framework and Cyber Kill Chain flow
  • Understanding of incident response processes and risk management.

Preferred:

  • Actively hold one or more of the following certifications:
    • GSEC, GCIA/GCED, GCDA, AZ-500, SC-200/SC-100, Network+ or CCNA.
    • Web Application Firewall rulesets
    • Utilizing automation through Infrastructure as Code.
    • Detection engineering (KQL/SPL), log pipelines, and data normalization.
    • Zero Trust architecture and ZTNA posture policies.
  • Understands Credit Acceptance’s business model, operations and business terminology.

Knowledge and Skills:

Understanding of breach methodologies and advanced attack methodologies, including living off the land; TTPs outlined in MITRE ATT&CK framework

  • Knowledge of Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs), cyber threats, and vulnerability mitigation strategies.
  • Understanding of what constitutes network risk, cyberattacks, and the relationship between threats and vulnerabilities
  • Demonstrates pride in work with a high attention to detail and a sense of urgency in meeting goals
  • Critical thinking and proactive problem-solving skills
  • Quick learner with the ability to apply new concepts effectively
  • Skilled at managing multiple priorities and optimizing resources
  • Self-motivated with the ability to identify and act on tasks independently.
  • Clear and effective communicator, both written and verbal, tailored to the audience
  • Influences without authority and demonstrates leadership in cross-functional settings
  • Synthesizes complex information from multiple sources to drive sound decisions and the best possible outcomes
  • Actively listens and understands context to respond appropriately
  • Recognizes and escalates risks through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

CTC Range: ₹ 24,21,038 - ₹ 35,50,856

Total Compensation (CTC): Final CTC will be shared during the offer stage and will include all compensation components in detail as per EoR vendor's structure.

Final compensation within the range is influenced by many factors including role-specific skills, depth and experience level, industry background, relevant education and certifications.

​

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EoR) partner in India.

  • You will be legally employed in India through our EoR partner

  • While your legal employer is the EoR partner, you will work full-time and be fully aligned to Credit Acceptance

  • Your day-to-day work, responsibilities, and performance expectations will be consistent with our global team members

  • You will receive locally compliant payroll, benefits, and statutory coverage through the EoR partner

Our Company Values:

To be successful in this role, Team Members need to be:

  • Positive by maintaining resiliency and focusing on solutions.

  • Respectful by collaborating and actively listening.

  • Insightful by cultivating innovation, accumulating business and role specific knowledge, demonstrating self-awareness and making quality decisions.

  • Direct by effectively communicating and conveying courage.

  • Earnest by taking accountability, applying feedback and effectively planning and priority setting.

Expectations:

  • Regularly overlap with U.S. business hours to support collaboration with global team members.

  • Remain compliant with our policies, processes and guidelines

  • All other duties as assigned

  • Attendance as required by department

jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking a Cloud FinOps Analyst to manage cloud financial operations for a large, multi-tenant AWS environment spanning both commercial and GovCloud accounts.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Cloud FinOps Analyst to manage cloud financial operations for a large, multi-tenant AWS environment spanning both commercial and GovCloud accounts. This role is responsible for improving cost visibility, accountability, and optimization across the organization.

The analyst will turn cloud usage and spending data into actionable insights for engineering and business teams, identifying opportunities to reduce costs while maintaining system performance, reliability, and availability. The FinOps Analyst will also provide consolidated cloud cost reporting and forecasting to leadership, finance, and engineering teams. Responsibilities include tracking monthly actuals, analyzing spending trends, managing chargeback and cost allocation, and developing fiscal-year cost projections.

This role works closely with finance, engineering, platform, and program teams to establish consistent FinOps practices and integrate cost management into the software development lifecycle. The goal is to make cloud costs transparent, predictable, and actionable so teams can make informed decisions about how they build and operate AWS services.

Location: Remote

Shift Schedule: 8am – 5pm Eastern Standard Time (EST)

What you will do:

Cost Optimization and Resource Right-Sizing

  • Analyze utilization data from AWS Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor, and CloudWatch to identify right-sizing opportunities across EC2, RDS, EBS, ELB, and container workloads.
  • Develop prioritized right-sizing recommendations with quantified savings, and partner with engineering owners to implement and validate those recommendations rather than simply delivering a report.
  • Identify idle, orphaned, and overprovisioned resources, and coordinate recurring remediation with the appropriate engineering and platform teams.
  • Manage Reserved Instance and Savings Plan strategy, including coverage analysis, purchase recommendations, utilization monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Reduce storage costs through S3 lifecycle policies, appropriate EBS volume types, intelligent tiering, and effective snapshot management.
  • Establish a continuous optimization process that incorporates cost efficiency into day-to-day cloud operations rather than addressing it only after costs increase.

Consolidated Cost Reporting and Analysis

  • Build and maintain consolidated monthly cost reports covering AWS spend, usage trends, unit economics, and optimization opportunities across accounts, business units, and programs.
  • Design and manage chargeback and showback models that allocate cloud costs to the appropriate business units with clear, transparent, and defensible cost attribution.
  • Implement and enforce a consistent cost-allocation tagging strategy across the AWS estate, and drive remediation of untagged or incorrectly tagged resources.
  • Develop executive dashboards and program-level scorecards using AWS Cost and Usage Reports to provide clear visibility into cloud spending and performance.
  • Perform root-cause analysis on cost anomalies and unexpected spending variances, and communicate findings and recommended actions clearly to both finance and engineering audiences.
  • Support cost governance and reporting across a multi-account AWS Organizations environment spanning commercial and GovCloud accounts under consolidated billing.

Forecasting and Budget Management

  • Develop fiscal-year cloud spend projections and monthly burn-rate views, and update forecasts as consumption, program scope, and pricing change.
  • Model the expected cost impact of architectural changes, migrations, and new workload onboarding before financial or engineering commitments are made.
  • Monitor budget utilization against plan, identify variances early, and recommend corrective actions to keep programs on track.
  • Support annual budgeting, quarterly reforecasts, and business-case development for cloud investments.
  • Configure and manage AWS Budgets and Cost Anomaly Detection thresholds, including the associated alerting, investigation, and response processes.

Governance, Collaboration, and FinOps Practice

  • Participate in cloud architecture reviews and provide cost estimates and financial guidance so teams understand the financial impact of design decisions before implementation.
  • Ensure compliance with financial policies, cloud governance frameworks, and organizational cost controls, including FedRAMP-aligned account and billing boundaries.
  • Partner with finance, IT, engineering, and program teams to align cloud financial strategy with organizational objectives and establish shared accountability for cloud spend.
  • Advance FinOps maturity across the organization through training, playbooks, standardized processes, and recurring cost-management reviews.
  • Automate recurring cost analysis, reporting, and tag-hygiene activities using Python or SQL to reduce manual effort and improve the scalability and consistency of FinOps operations.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance.
  • Bachelor's degree with 8 years of experience; a Master's degree with 6 years of experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years of experience.
  • 5+ years of financial analysis experience, with at least 3 years focused on cloud cost management on AWS.
  • Proven experience implementing resource right-sizing at scale, with quantified cost outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience producing consolidated cost reports, chargeback models, and fiscal year projections.
  • Proven experience participating in cloud architectural reviews and providing cost estimates for proposed designs.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting and forecasting.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner or FinOps Certified Professional.
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate, or Cloud Financial Management specialty.
  • Experience with third-party FinOps or cloud cost management platforms such as Apptio Cloudability, CloudHealth, or Vantage.
  • Experience operating in a multi-account AWS Organizations environment with consolidated billing, including GovCloud.
  • Experience consolidating bills across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container cost allocation, including tools such as Kubecost or OpenCost.
  • Experience supporting FedRAMP, FISMA, or DoD-accredited environments.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

About Character Biosciences

Character Biosciences is a precision medicine company pioneering targeted therapies for ophthalmology. Our patient data platform integrates genomics with deep, longitudinal clinical and imaging data, enabling us to uncover genetic drivers of disease progression, advance novel therapeutics, and define patient stratification strategies that improve clinical success.

Our interdisciplinary team spans human genetics, clinical science, data science and engineering, and drug discovery and development. We are advancing two programs for Dry Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) into the clinic, with additional discovery-stage programs underway.

Founded in 2018, Character has raised capital from leading investors at the intersection of healthcare and technology, including an oversubscribed $110+ million Series B in 2025 co-led by aMoon and Luma Group, with participation from Bausch + Lomb, Innovation Endeavors, Sanofi Ventures, Catalio Capital Management, S32, KdT Ventures, and Jefferson Life Sciences. We also maintain a multi-target drug discovery collaboration with Bausch + Lomb to develop innovative precision medicines for AMD.

Role: Associate Director, Development Operations

Reports to: Aggie Malloy

Department: Clinical Research

Team: Development Operations

Level: 8

Location: Remote

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced, execution-focused Associate Director, Development Operations to lead the operational backbone of Character’s clinical programs as we advance our Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) pipeline through the clinic. You’ll take ownership of a portfolio of studies — driving day-to-day execution, vendor and site performance, and cross-functional coordination with Medical, Data, and Regulatory to keep our trials on time, on budget, and in compliance with GCP. This role sits at the center of Character’s mission: the operational rigor you bring directly determines how quickly we can generate the clinical evidence needed to bring novel therapies to patients with retinal disease.

You’ll shape how we run trials as much as you’ll run them, refining processes and systems so they scale cleanly as our pipeline and team grow, while staying close enough to the work to solve problems in real time. As Character’s clinical portfolio and Development Operations function scale, there is real opportunity to build and lead a team over time.

This is an in-office or remote role reporting to Aggie Malloy.

Responsibilities

Clinical Trial Operations & Delivery

  • Study Execution: Own operational delivery of one or more Dry AMD clinical trials, driving timelines, quality, and issue resolution from startup through close-out
  • Operational Strategy: Oversee development of study-level operational plans and risk mitigation strategies in partnership with relevant functions
  • Regulatory Activities: Provides input and support for regulatory activities including NDAs, MAAs, inspection readiness activities and serves as a subject matter expert during regulatory inspections
  • Vendor & CRO Management: Oversees and responsible for vendor identification and selection including critical review of contracts, and/or work orders and management of ongoing performance as well as vendor relationships
  • Monitoring/Site Oversight: Oversee CRO monitoring activities to ensure site performance, enrollment, and data quality meet study goals
  • Budget Oversight: Support development and tracking of study and program budgets, flagging variances and ensuring fiscal discipline

Process, Compliance & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Operational Excellence: Build and refine SOPs, systems, and workflows that make clinical operations scalable as Character’s pipeline grows
  • GCP Compliance: Ensure trials are conducted to GCP and applicable regulatory standards; maintain inspection-ready trial master files and clinical systems
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with the internal cross-functional team to keep operational plans aligned with program strategy
  • Executive Reporting: Provide clear, timely updates on study status, risks, and timelines to program and senior leadership
  • Team Building: Help shape Development Operations processes and structure at Character, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as the function grows

About You

You bring deep, hands-on clinical operations experience and are energized by the chance to help build the operational foundation for a growing ophthalmology-focused biotech. You move fluidly between the details of day-to-day trial execution and the bigger picture of how our operational processes need to evolve as Character’s pipeline advances. You’re comfortable owning a portfolio of studies independently, anticipating risks before they become issues, and driving vendors and cross-functional partners toward shared timelines.

You are collaborative, detail-oriented, and thrive in a fast-moving, resource-lean environment where processes are still being built. You bring credibility and sound judgment to partner effectively with cross functional colleagues. Like us, you value integrity, individual accountability, team camaraderie, open communication, and a commitment to continuous learning and operational excellence.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred
  • 5–7+ years of Clinical Operations experience across multiple trial phases, including 2+ years of ophthalmology experience (retina experience a plus)
  • Extensive experience managing CROs, vendors, and sites, with a strong understanding of GCP, ICH guidelines, and clinical trial regulations
  • Proven ability to shape operational strategy and drive execution across more than one study or program at a time
  • Strong budget and vendor management skills, with experience tracking spend and flagging variances
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills; able to partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of independence in a lean, fast-moving biotech environment
  • High integrity, strong judgment, and a track record of delivering complex clinical trials on time and within budget

Compensation & Benefits

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $179,000-$210,000 + equity + benefits. Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, certifications and work location.

Benefits include a competitive salary, strong equity incentives, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and an accrued paid time off policy. Character is committed to recruiting, developing, and supporting colleagues from all backgrounds. We embrace diversity, equity, and inclusion as an integral part of our culture.

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Sr. Data Analyst

Join us in delivering cutting-edge technology solutions for the world’s best brands.

  • Apply your IT knowledge and experience to solve complex and constantly evolving technology challenges in the context of an energetic, entrepreneurial culture.
  • Work on Sedgwick’s industry-leading proprietary technologies and platforms – with like-minded technology experts aligned on the same goals.
  • Deliver innovative customer-facing technology solutions to clients who represent virtually every industry and comprise some of the world’s most respected brands.
  • Be a part of a rapidly growing, industry-leading global company known for its excellence and customer service.
  • Take advantage of a variety of professional development opportunities that help you perform your best work and grow your career.
  • Enjoy flexibility and autonomy in your daily work, your location, and your career path.
  • Access diverse and comprehensive benefits to take care of your mental, physical, financial and professional needs.

PRIMARY PURPOSE OF THE ROLE: The Senior Data Analyst is a key individual contributor responsible for transforming complex data into meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations. This role blends strong technical analytics capabilities with a business-focused mindset, partnering closely with stakeholders across the casualty and managed care business unit to drive informed decision-making and operational improvements.

ARE YOU AN IDEAL CANDIDATE? The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience working with data and analytics tools but stands out for their ability to interpret trends, identify opportunities, and influence business outcomes through data storytelling and strategic recommendations.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBLITIES MAY INCLUDE:

  • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and performance opportunities, translating findings into clear business insights and recommendations
  • Partner with business leaders and subject‑matter experts to define problems, shape analytical approaches, and influence strategic decisions
  • Design, develop, and optimize analytical datasets and data models in Snowflake to support scalable reporting and insight generation
  • Write complex SQL queries and leverage Python to extract, transform, and analyze data, enabling deeper business understanding
  • Build and maintain dashboards that not only report metrics but highlight key insights, risks, and opportunities
  • Use modern AI forward analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Snowflake) to perform exploratory analysis and develop repeatable workflows that support ongoing business evaluation
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for leadership and cross‑functional teams
  • Ensure data accuracy and integrity through validation, documentation, and adherence to governance standards
  • Act as a trusted advisor by connecting data insights to business strategy and operational improvements
  • Mentor junior analysts on both technical skills and insight generation best practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Technical & Analytical Expertise:

  • Strong hands‑on experience with Snowflake (data modeling, analytics use cases)
  • Advanced SQL skills for querying and data transformation
  • Python experience for data analysis, automation, and modeling
  • Expertise in creating dashboards that drive business understanding and decision‑making
  • Experience with Hex or similar analytics platforms
  • Experience with Snowflake Cortex Code (CoCo), Cursor or other code generating AI tools

Business & Insight Skills:

  • Proven ability to work with large, complex datasets and translate findings into business insights
  • Strong analytical thinking with the ability to connect data to real‑world business impact
  • Demonstrated experience providing recommendations that influence outcomes

Education & Licensing

  • Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related quantitative field.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or business analysis–focused roles
  • Experience supporting operational or business teams with data-driven insights and recommendations
  • Insurance or managed care experience is a plus

TAKING CARE OF YOU

  • Career development and promotional growth opportunities.
  • A diverse and comprehensive benefits offering including medical, dental vision, 401k, PTO and more.

Work environment requirements for entry-level opportunities include –

Physical: Computer keyboarding

Auditory/visual: Hearing, vision and talking
Mental: Clear and conceptual thinking ability; excellent judgement and discretion; ability to meet deadlines

NEXT STEPS

If your application is selected to advance to the next round, a recruiter will be in touch.

As required by law, Sedgwick provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired in jurisdictions requiring pay transparency in job postings. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide range of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and cost of specific location. For the jurisdiction noted in this job posting only, the range of starting pay for this role is $75,000 - $85,000/year. A comprehensive benefits package is offered including but not limited to, medical, dental, vision, 401k and matching, PTO, disability and life insurance, employee assistance, flexible spending or health savings account, and other additional voluntary benefits.

Sedgwick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.

If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, consider applying for it anyway! Sedgwick is building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and recognizes that each person possesses a unique combination of skills, knowledge, and experience. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Director of Revenue Enablement
jobs.excerpt: About Inspira EducationInspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US.
jobs.description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic and collaborative Director of Revenue Enablement to help scale our go-to-market organization. In this role, you'll partner across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, Recruiting, and Learning & Development to ensure our customer-facing teams have the knowledge, tools, processes, and content they need to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive business results.

You'll serve as the connective tissue across our GTM organization—translating strategy into execution, identifying performance gaps, enabling successful product launches, and creating scalable programs that improve sales effectiveness and customer outcomes.

If you enjoy solving sales challenges, influencing cross-functional teams, and building programs that have measurable impact, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do

Sales Enablement & Training

  • Design, build, and continuously improve onboarding programs to accelerate new-hire ramp time.
  • Develop ongoing training programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultative selling, objection handling, and customer experience.
  • Create certifications, learning paths, coaching resources, and sales enablement programs.
  • Analyze sales performance trends and identify opportunities for targeted enablement initiatives.

Data & Feedback Loop

  • Analyze conversion, win/loss, and retention data to identify what's working and feed it back into training
  • Review call recordings and customer interactions to surface best practices from top performers and turn them into repeatable playbooks
  • Track and report on enablement-specific metrics and their downstream impact on conversion or win rate

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning, messaging, and competitive insights into practical sales playbooks, talk tracks, FAQs, and customer-facing resources.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prepare customer-facing teams for product launches by developing training, enablement content, and readiness plans.
  • Work closely with Marketing to ensure campaign messaging is consistently reflected throughout the customer journey.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations to support CRM adoption, process improvements, sales workflows, and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with Customer Experience and Customer Success teams to improve onboarding, retention, upsell, and support experiences.
  • Gather frontline feedback and communicate customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Sales Leadership to continuously improve our GTM strategy.

Content & Communication

  • Create and refine high-converting playbooks, call scripts, objection-handling guides, and cross-sell/upsell matrices for the sales team.
  • Own the organization and maintenance of sales enablement content, including playbooks, product documentation, competitive battle cards, sales presentations, and knowledge resources.
  • Ensure customer-facing teams have easy access to current, accurate, and actionable enablement materials.
  • Package customer proof points, case studies, and FAQs into reusable assets teams can pull from in the moment
  • Develop scalable communication plans for product launches, process updates, and organizational changes.

Tools & Process

  • Own or co-own enablement tooling (e.g., CRM/helpdesk macros, content/asset libraries, call recording platforms) so teams can find the right resource in seconds, not minutes
  • Partner with RevOps to keep CRM data clean and process consistent across teams

What You'll Bring

  • Prior experience carrying an individual sales quota or serving in a consultative customer-facing role (Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Customer Success, Retail Leadership, or similar). You understand firsthand what it takes to build trust with customers, navigate objections, and operate in a performance-driven environment.
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing revenue role and/or Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, Sales Operations, Product Marketing, or a related GTM function.
  • Experience designing and scaling enablement programs that improve onboarding, sales readiness, product adoption, or customer experience.
  • Proven ability to build trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Experience, and executive leadership.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and influence audiences ranging from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • An analytical mindset with experience using performance metrics, customer feedback, and business insights to identify opportunities and measure the impact of enablement initiatives.
  • A builder's mentality—you enjoy creating scalable programs, playbooks, and processes that help teams perform at their best.
  • High emotional intelligence and credibility. You listen before prescribing solutions, seek to understand the realities of frontline teams, and earn trust through empathy, collaboration, and thoughtful execution.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a direct-to-consumer, retail, consumer technology, marketplace, or high-growth environment.
  • Experience supporting product launches and go-to-market initiatives across multiple customer-facing teams.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), learning management systems, and enablement tools such as Gong, Highspot, Seismic, WorkRamp, or similar platforms.
  • Experience coaching managers or facilitating leadership development programs.

Success in This Role

After your first 60-days, you will have:

  • Built scalable onboarding and ongoing enablement programs that improve sales readiness and consistency.
  • Successfully enabled multiple product launches across customer-facing teams.
  • Established trusted partnerships across Sales, Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Customer Experience.
  • Increased adoption of key sales processes, tools, and messaging.
  • Demonstrated measurable improvements in ramp time, productivity, customer experience, or sales effectiveness.
  • Become a strategic partner who helps connect business strategy with frontline execution.

Why This Role Matters

Our customers experience our brand through every interaction with our teams. This role helps ensure those interactions are consistent, informed, and customer-centric. By connecting strategy with execution and enabling our teams to perform at their best, you'll play a critical role in helping us scale our business while delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Why You'll Love Inspira

  • Amazing people with a great vision and values
  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance, base plans 100% employer paid
  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays
  • 401(k) with company match

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: ServiceNow Alliance Executive
jobs.excerpt: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
jobs.description:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Vonage Sales Mission

At Vonage, we’re redefining how businesses communicate in today’s fast-moving digital, cloud, and real-time world. Our Sales team is high-energy, customer-focused, and relentlessly innovative - committed to delivering cutting-edge UCaaS, CCaaS, and AI-powered solutions.

As a ServiceNowAlliance Executive, you’ll be at the forefront of our ServiceNow ecosystem strategy—expanding our footprint and influence by building and managing powerful relationships.

Why this role matters:

The ServiceNow Alliances team is a key growth engine for Vonage—driving pipeline and revenue by aligning our business with ServiceNow and its extended ecosystem. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on relationship-building, strategic partnerships, and go-to-market execution.

We’re looking for someone experienced in the ServiceNow ecosystem or with a strong background in partner management or alliances. If this sounds like you—keep reading!

Your key responsibilities:

  • Drive Servicenow referral business
  • Build, nurture, and manage relationships with Servicenow teams and ecosystem partners
  • Align Vonage’s sales reps with their Servicenow counterparts to generate pipeline and close opportunities
  • Own executive alignment and sales engagement—position Vonage asServicenow’s top communication partner
  • Plan and lead joint field events with Servicenow (both partner-facing and customer-facing)
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within Vonage to maintain momentum on partner strategy and joint outcomes
  • Coordinate and run interlocks, milestone tracking, and strategy sessions with partners and internal stakeholders
  • Drive execution of regional go-to-market strategies with Servicenow and other alliance partners
  • Deliver internal training sessions to equip Sales, Product, Services, and Support teams on partner ecosystem updates
  • Represent Vonage at industry events, promoting our brand and ecosystem value
  • Manage technical and business escalations to maintain partner success and deal velocity
  • Execute against established revenue, activity, and relationship goals
  • Support ongoing optimization of alliance processes to enhance partner program impact

Who you are:

  • A relationship-driven professional who thrives in a partner-centric ecosystem
  • Experienced in working with alliances, channel sales, or ecosystem partnerships
  • Strategic and detail-oriented with a passion for joint value creation and partner enablement
  • Capable of influencing cross-functional teams and engaging with executive-level stakeholders
  • An excellent communicator—able to tailor messages to various audiences and formats
  • Comfortable analyzing complex data and solving problems with a collaborative mindset
  • Experience within the Servicenow ecosystem is a plus

What you'll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Proven experience in Alliance Partner Management, Partner Sales, or Channel Development
  • Strong track record of recruiting, onboarding, and enabling partners
  • Prior experience or familiarity with the Salesforce ecosystem is a must
  • Prior direct sales experience is a huge plus
  • A desire to succeed and a “get-it-done” attitude

How you’ll benefit:

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based incentives
  • Fully remote flexibility
  • Dynamic, inclusive, and supportive team culture
  • Career advancement opportunities with a clear growth path
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Unlimited discretionary PTO and tuition reimbursement
  • Opportunities to work on industry-defining technologies and partnerships

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Who we are:

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

jobs.title: Senior Android Developer
jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a Senior Android Developer to join our team and help build high-quality, scalable, and innovative mobile applications.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Android Developer to join our team and help build high-quality, scalable, and innovative mobile applications. As a senior member of our development team, you will lead Android projects, mentor junior developers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver top-tier mobile experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced applications for the Android platform.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and scalable code using Kotlin/Java.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to define app requirements and user experiences.
  • Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
  • Work with APIs, message brokers, databases, and cloud services to integrate mobile applications with backend systems.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and bugs.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Android development best practices and emerging trends.
  • Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers.
  • Ensure applications comply with security and data privacy regulations.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Android application development.
  • Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
  • Deep understanding of the Android SDK, Jetpack libraries, and Material Design principles.
  • Experience with MVVM, MVP, or Clean Architecture.
  • Proficiency in RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and third-party integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of dependency injection frameworks (e.g., Dagger, Hilt).
  • Experience with unit testing, UI testing, and test automation frameworks.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git).
  • Knowledge of security best practices for mobile applications.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Jetpack Compose.
  • Knowledge of Flutter or React Native for cross-platform development.
  • Published apps on the Google Play Store.
  • Experience in the Fintech industry and credit card payments systems.

jobs.title: Senior Network Automation Engineer (EU)
jobs.excerpt: About MegaportWe’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be.
jobs.description:
About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

You’re a senior engineer who is well respected by your peers, and know how to lead effectively. You find joy in making a product that customers love. You love taking ownership over your work and can balance managing technical debt with improving the user’s experience / adding product features. You are interested in the newest technology and you’d like an environment where you can share your skills with like minded people on a no ego team. We’re a tech company at our core and we have an interesting domain we work in. And we want you to join us!

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Contribute to enhancing our existing Perl code base powering our network automation systems and internal toolset. Implement new code using a modular approach with automated testing and reporting on code coverage.

  • Identify and reduce technical debt, improve performance and reliability, and participate in scaling decisions across our platform.

  • Build and maintain secure, scalable RESTful APIs. Ensure adherence to API standards, versioning practices, and monitoring instrumentation.

  • Play a key role in our release process by writing reliable tests, reviewing code rigorously, and contributing to CI/CD pipeline improvements.

  • Support the growth of junior engineers through pairing, thoughtful code reviews, and informal coaching. Promote sound design principles and foster a culture of continuous technical learning.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of software development experience using Perl and frameworks like Mojolicious.

  • Experience working with relational databases using SQL (preferably PostgreSQL).

  • Working knowledge of using distributed datastores and NoSQL (Cassandra or similar).

  • Proven experience building backend services and tools within web application ecosystems.

  • Ability to act as a technical lead for small projects (typically up to 4 developers), offering architectural and design guidance.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Sharp logical reasoning skills and a habit of asking the right questions, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and succinctly.

  • Determined to automate as much as possible so you can focus on the bigger picture.

  • An ability to reason logically, question appropriately and present technical information clearly and concisely.

  • Experience maintaining scalable versioned, secure REST APIs

  • Experience with networking concepts such as IP routing and MPLS

What We Offer

  • Flexible working environment – a remote-first culture with coworking options available

  • Generous leave plans – including, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program

  • Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives

  • Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus paid study leave

  • Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely, plus access to coworking spaces via our global WeWork membership if you work remotely, but like to get out of the house sometimes

  • Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent

  • Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our Legend and Kudos award

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
All applications will be treated in confidence.

jobs.title: Freelance Performance Creative Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions.
jobs.description:
AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.

Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Creative Designer, der visuell starke und performanceorientierte Creatives für unsere Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages und unseren Onlineshop entwickelt.

Du solltest nicht nur ein ausgezeichnetes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie und Bildsprache besitzen, sondern auch verstehen, wie Designs im E-Commerce funktionieren: von einem aufmerksamkeitsstarken Einstieg über eine klare visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zu einer überzeugenden Produktinszenierung und einem eindeutigen Call-to-Action.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst performanceorientierte statische Werbeanzeigen und Grafiken für Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google und weitere digitale Kanäle.
  • Du gestaltest unterschiedliche Creative Angles, Hooks, Layouts und Varianten, damit wir Botschaften und visuelle Ansätze gezielt testen können.
  • Du verwandelst Produktbilder, UGC-Material, Testimonials, Benefits und Werbetexte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke und verkaufsorientierte Creatives.
  • Du gestaltest visuelle Konzepte, Seitenlayouts und einzelne Bereiche für Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.
  • Du entwickelst unter anderem Hero Sections, Produkt-Benefit-Grafiken, Vergleichsdarstellungen, Anwendungsanleitungen, Vorher-Nachher-Visuals, Trust-Elemente und weitere Conversion-Elemente.
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Marke, Produkt, Anwendung, Vorteile und Ergebnisse von AYLASHES hochwertig und verständlich präsentiert werden.
  • Du adaptierst Creatives für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Platzierungen und Formate – insbesondere 1:1, 4:5 und 9:16 sowie weitere Display- und Webformate.
  • Du achtest bei allen Formaten auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit, mobile Darstellung und eine konsistente visuelle Qualität.
  • Du entwickelst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Bildern, Headlines, Farben, Layouts oder CTAs.
  • Du setzt bestehende Brand-Vorgaben sicher um und entwickelst unsere visuelle Kommunikation gemeinsam mit uns weiter.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team zusammen, setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst eigene Ideen und Empfehlungen ein.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Performance Creatives für Meta, TikTok, Google oder vergleichbare Paid-Media-Kanäle.
  • Du besitzt ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit relevanten Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs – idealerweise aus den Bereichen Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle oder D2C.
  • Du verstehst die grundlegende Creative Strategy hinter erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen und weißt, warum Hook, visuelle Hierarchie, Produktinszenierung, Lesbarkeit, Social Proof und CTA entscheidend sind.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit conversionorientiertem Web- und Landingpage-Design und kannst ansprechende Layouts entwickeln, die auch auf mobilen Geräten funktionieren.
  • Du beherrschst relevante Designprogramme sicher, beispielsweise Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign oder vergleichbare Tools.
  • Du hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Farben, Komposition, Bildauswahl und modernes E-Commerce-Design.
  • Du kannst Informationen visuell priorisieren und auch komplexere Produktvorteile schnell verständlich darstellen.
  • Du weißt, wie man eine hochwertige Markenwirkung mit klarer, performanceorientierter Kommunikation verbindet.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und detailgenau und hältst vereinbarte Deadlines zuverlässig ein.
  • Du kannst deutschsprachige Werbetexte sicher verarbeiten und erkennst, wenn eine Headline oder Botschaft im Design nicht optimal funktioniert.
  • Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Creative Iterations und der Auswertung von Ad-Performance ist ein starkes Plus.
  • Erfahrung mit einfachen Animationen, Motion Graphics oder KI-gestützter Bildbearbeitung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Flexible und ortsunabhängige Zusammenarbeit auf Freelance-Basis.
  • Die Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigen Projekten und planbaren Aufgaben.
  • Abwechslungsreiche Designprojekte für Paid Social, Google Ads, Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.
  • Klare Briefings, vorhandene Brand-Guidelines, Produktmaterialien und Werbetexte als Grundlage für deine Arbeit.
  • Direkte Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und konkrete Feedback-Loops.
  • Einblicke in die Performance deiner Creatives, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, welche Designs funktionieren und warum.
  • Raum für eigene Ideen, neue Designkonzepte und kreative Testansätze.
  • Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden D2C-Beauty-Brand aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Faire und transparente Vergütung, abgestimmt auf Erfahrung, Qualität und Projektumfang.

Wir benötigen weder einen klassischen Lebenslauf noch ein Anschreiben. Entscheidend sind die Qualität deiner Arbeit, dein Gespür für Ästhetik und deine bisherigen Ergebnisse.

Bitte sende uns mit deiner Bewerbung:

  • fünf bis acht deiner stärksten und relevantesten Arbeiten,
  • Beispiele für Performance Ads sowie, wenn vorhanden, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs,
  • eine kurze Information dazu, was du bei den gezeigten Projekten übernommen hast,
  • wenn möglich, konkrete Ergebnisse oder Erkenntnisse zur Performance deiner Arbeiten,
  • deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit und ungefähre wöchentliche Kapazität,
  • deine Preisvorstellung pro Creative, Stunden- oder Paketpreis.
