Standard Job Description

Applies quality principles in the areas of: design, incoming material, production control, product evaluation, program performance, reliability, inventory control, and/or research and development as they apply to product or process quality for make and/or buy products. Performs technical evaluations including product requirements, specifications, models/designs, drawings and procedures. Collaborates with program management, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and customers on quality related issues to ensure quality standards are in place. Engages in product failure investigations, material review board decisions and corrective/preventive action. Ensures corrective measures meet acceptable reliability standards and/or are compliant with requirements. Develops strategies and systems designed to improve internal and/or supplier performance and productivity. Evaluates quality systems for deficiency identification and correction. Analyzes inspection and testing processes, mechanisms and equipment; conducts product quality tests, performs statistical analysis to assess products or materials that do not meet required standards and specifications. Engages in supplier selection process and maintain certification programs.

This position will support the Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Supplier Quality AMMM Integration Team focusing on improving and managing supplier performance primarily in the Atlanta area. While this position is aligned with the AMMM program, these suppliers do support other aeronautics programs.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with root cause and corrective action (RCCA)
  • Knowledge of AS9100
  • Effective communication skills - Written, oral, listening, presentation, and technical writing
  • Experience working independently and with minimal supervision
  • Experience identifying and engaging relevant stakeholders for collaboration
  • High energy, self-starting, team player who achieves goals.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

Desired Skills

  • Supplier Quality Management experience
  • Bachelor's Degree in a Technical field or 5 years related experience.
  • Supplier Quality Engineer experience
  • Previous experience with Lockheed Martin supplier quality requirements.
  • Experienced understanding and application of AS9100 / AS9102.
  • Experience in auditing suppliers to contractual requirements and AS standards.
  • Experience with reading and interpreting engineering requirements and specifications and applying their intent for evaluating acceptance of quality products.
  • Experience developing performance improvements plans (e.g. zero defect plans, return-to-green plans).
  • Experience interacting with one or more of the following: Program Management, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, and/or Government Customer Representatives.
  • Experience with aerospace manufacturing, machining, and assembly work.
  • Green Belt, Black Belt, or CQE certification.
  • Demonstrated quality science expertise in one or more of the following areas: Statistical analysis, statistical process control, sampling, six sigma, FAI, PPAP, PFMEA, process auditing or validation, root cause analysis and corrective action validations, and supplier quality management.

The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
As a Fraud Operations Manager, you will play a critical, strategic leadership role responsible for overseeing operations across multiple Fraud Operations teams and pods, including those focused on disputes and compliance work. You will lead and develop people leaders and Individual Contributors (ICs) and be accountable for defining and executing a strategy to improve team function and drive scalable efficiency. A primary focus is cultivating a high-performance, psychologically safe culture that ensures teams meet business objectives, including productivity and accuracy, while fostering a strong sense of belonging, inclusion, and personal development.

What you'll do

Lead & Develop Talent

  • Lead, coach, and develop a group of people leaders and Individual Contributors (ICs) across multiple, specialized teams/pods, providing ongoing feedback, performance management, and career development to build long-term organizational capability.
  • Drive team performance using key metrics such as productivity, quality, customer outcomes, and service levels
  • Foster a high-performing, engaged team environment that operates effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Partner with recruiting to hire, onboard, and retain top talent

Set Strategy & Own Program Performance

  • Define and champion a clear operational strategy and roadmap to significantly improve the function, efficiency, quality, and compliance of your assigned teams/pods.
  • Drive operational excellence by leveraging domain expertise to identify and implement transformational changes and efficiencies that simplify investigator workflows.
  • Ensure full accountability for service levels and productivity of assigned areas, proactively managing queue health through data-driven burn down plans to maintain a healthy buffer.

Drive Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Translate broader business goals into clear team-level objectives, providing clear, transparent communication to ensure operational alignment.
  • Proactively identify and mitigate systemic issues by looking beyond standard reporting and collaborating with cross-functional partners.
  • Serve as the ultimate escalation point for complex merchant, user, or internal stakeholder issues, establishing robust frameworks for incident resolution
  • Research and resolve risk events stemming from process breakdowns.

What we look for

  • 6+ years of direct experience in disputes, fraud risk prevention and detection within FinTech/tech industry
  • 5+ years of experience in fraud management or related people management roles, including proven experience leading managers or senior ICs.
  • Demonstrated success setting strategy and delivering large-scale operational change with measurable impact on efficiency, quality, and customer experience.
  • Strong strategic planning, risk management, and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance short-term delivery and long-term capability building.
  • Exceptional executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to align diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven experience in leading teams through major change and comfort with ambiguity.
  • Ability to maintain composure and act as a role model when presented with barriers or when results are not as expected.
  • Experience with AI project-driven initiatives (e.g., leveraging AI-enabled tools, agent assist, or automation to improve operational efficiency or knowledge management).
  • Experience in Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement practices, and/or data-driven methodologies to drive scalable efficiency.
  • Working knowledge of scripting & querying languages (e.g., Python, SQL) is a plus.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - $180,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge

Senior Client Relationship Manager (Financial Institutions)

Position Summary

The Senior Client Relationship Manager (Senior CRM) is responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic Financial Institution clients while driving revenue growth, retention, and operational excellence.
The role serves as a trusted advisor to clients and an internal advocate for customer success, combining deep expertise in cross-border payments, foreign exchange, operational workflows, and relationship management.
The Senior CRM manages larger and more complex client relationships than a CRM and is expected to proactively identify opportunities, resolve complex issues independently, and influence client outcomes through strategic engagement and commercial leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management

  • Own a portfolio of strategic Financial Institution clients.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers and operational stakeholders.
  • Lead regular business reviews and service discussions.
  • Act as the primary escalation point for client issues and service concerns.
  • Develop and execute account strategies to improve retention and grow wallet share.

Revenue Growth

  • Identify opportunities to increase payment volumes, FX revenue, and product adoption.
  • Monitor client activity and market trends to uncover growth opportunities.
  • Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Dealers to develop commercial opportunities.
  • Maintain an accurate pipeline and opportunity record in Salesforce.

Operational Leadership

  • Coordinate internal teams to ensure a seamless customer experience.
  • Manage complex operational, regulatory, contractual, and servicing issues.
  • Drive resolution of client escalations and identify root causes of recurring problems.
  • Monitor client activity for trends, risks, and service improvement opportunities.

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Develop deep expertise in Convera's payment and FX solutions.
  • Understand the regulatory and operational environments in which Financial Institutions operate.
  • Provide guidance internally on client requirements, servicing models, and industry trends.
  • Support new product launches, migrations, and strategic initiatives.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Support onboarding and training of newer CRMs.
  • Share best practices and provide coaching across the team.
  • Act as a senior resource and escalation point for complex client situations.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and operating model enhancements.

Qualifications

Required Experience:
  • 5+ years' experience in relationship management, account management, payments, banking, treasury, fintech, or foreign exchange.
  • Experience managing Financial Institution clients or complex B2B relationships.
  • Proven track record of revenue growth and account retention.

  • Exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About the Company

What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

About the role

The Senior Deployment Engineer is a senior-level technical field engineering role responsible for leading the deployment, commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and operational readiness of Armada’s modular data center infrastructure across North America and global customer environments.

This role serves as a key technical authority during deployment operations and is responsible for independently driving complex field execution activities across electrical, mechanical, controls/BAS, networking, and low-voltage infrastructure systems. The Senior Deployment Engineer exercises significant independent judgment in diagnosing infrastructure issues, coordinating technical resolution efforts, and ensuring operational reliability across mission-critical deployments.

This position requires a highly experienced infrastructure professional capable of making real-time technical decisions in dynamic field environments while partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Deployment Leadership, Customer Operations, and external vendors.

Location. This role is remote with extensive travel.

Deployment & Field Leadership

  • Conduct site assessments and provide technical leadership for field execution, issue resolution, and operational acceptance

Technical Ownership & Troubleshooting

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis efforts across electrical, mechanical, controls/BAS, networking, and monitoring systems
  • Interpret and apply electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, control diagrams, and infrastructure documentation to resolve complex operational issues
  • Make independent technical decisions during commissioning, startup, and live operational events
  • Drive corrective action implementation and long-term reliability improvements based on field findings
  • Escalate and coordinate resolution of critical infrastructure issues impacting deployment timelines or operational readiness

Operational Readiness & Infrastructure Validation

  • Lead BMS, EPMS, and DCIM integration, validation, and operational readiness testing activities
  • Define and execute infrastructure validation procedures to ensure systems meet performance, safety, and operational standards prior to customer turnover
  • Support incident response, infrastructure recovery efforts, and operational continuity initiatives
  • Provide technical oversight during system startup, monitoring validation, alarm testing, and infrastructure acceptance activities

Cross-Functional Technical Leadership

  • Partner directly with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Deployment Leadership, and Customer Operations teams to drive successful deployment execution
  • Coordinate technical activities with vendors, subcontractors, and field service partners
  • Provide field-driven operational insights that influence infrastructure design, deployment methodologies, and product reliability improvements
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor during deployment planning, execution, and operational review activities

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in mission-critical infrastructure, modular data centers, field engineering, or critical facilities operations
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead commissioning, startup, troubleshooting, and deployment activities within complex technical environments
  • Deep technical expertise across critical infrastructure systems including:
    • Electrical systems
    • Mechanical/HVAC systems
    • Controls/BAS systems
    • Low-voltage systems
  • Strong experience leading root cause analysis and technical problem resolution in live operational environments
  • Experience exercising independent judgment and decision-making during infrastructure deployments and operational events
  • Strong familiarity with BMS, EPMS, and/or DCIM platforms
  • Ability to read, interpret, and apply electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and control diagrams during field execution and troubleshooting
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-accountability deployment environments

We use a geographic pay structure based on cost-of-labor markets.

  • Tier 2 (most U.S. metro areas): $137,040 – $171,300
  • Tier 3 (other cities): $130,190 – $162,740

Final compensation will be determined by experience, scope, and level, and may vary from the posted range.

In addition to base salary, this role will also be offered equity and subsidized benefits(details available upon request).

Compensation
$137,040—$171,300 USD

  • A detail-oriented problem-solver. You can independently gather information, solve problems efficiently, and deliver results with a "get-it-done" attitude

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Position Overview:Any plausible pathway to the goals of the Paris Agreement includes the preservation of the Earth’s natural carbon sinks.
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Any plausible pathway to the goals of the Paris Agreement includes the preservation of the Earth’s natural carbon sinks. On land, the most important of these sinks are tropical forests, which hold nearly half of terrestrial carbon and biodiversity. Their destruction for unsustainable agriculture and timber creates 10-15% of anthropgenic carbon emissions – more than the entire European Union.

Emergent is a mission-focused focused non-profit designed to create a pathway to zero tropical deforestation. Emergent acts as an intermediary between forest countries and the private sector, facilitating transactions of high-integrity carbon credits from national-scale forest protection programmes. Backed by a coalition of governments, NGOs and major corporations, Emergent is catalysing a market that will channel billions of dollars of new funding into tropical forest protection and sustainable development. More information on Emergent and its approach is below.

With credits expected to become available in 2022 and initial transaction volumes in the tens of millions of tons (tCO2e) building to hundreds of millions of tons within a few years, Emergent expects to receive substantial flows of private sector funds underwritten by sovereign guarantees. The Chief Portfolio Officer (CPO) will be an integral member of Emergent’s Executive team and will lead and oversee Emergent’s Portfolio team. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dynamic leader and team player to join an ambitious, mission-focused group working to create a plausible, market-driven pathway to zero deforestation.

Responsibilities

Under the CPO’s leadership, the Portfolio team will (1) negotiate terms, structure agreements and execute transactions; (2) deploy sovereign-backed purchase guarantees; and (3) manage portfolio concentration and counterparty reputational risks. The role may be expanded to include oversight of a specialist team responsible for administering the flow of funds from credit sales to forest jurisdictions, including post-transaction reporting on the use of those funds.

Specific responsibilities:

  • Design and implement the resilient and scalable processes, policies, controls, infrastructure and partnerships Emergent needs to manage multi-million dollar transactions safely and with the confidence of its board, customers, suppliers and philanthropic/donor backers.
  • Maximise sales and minimise portfolio risk.
  • ·Oversee ERPA negotiations and contract finalisation, with external legal support as required.
  • Execute transactions once ERPAs are signed, including delivery of credits and receipt of funds.
  • Develop and manage Emergent’s strategy for credit placement with buyers.
  • Establish, develop, and lead Emergent’s Investment Committee.
  • Manage and report on Emergent’s portfolio risks.
  • Develop and execute Emergent’s strategy for use of its donor-funded floor price guarantee facility.
  • Work closely with Emergent’s Origination and Commercialisation teams to ensure that transaction and portfolio management are effectively integrated across Emergent.
  • Work closely with Emergent’s Chief Finance & Operations Officer to ensure integrated management of Emergent’s financial position and risk.

Requirements of the Role

Essential experience and attributes:

  • 15+ years’ experience of executing complex transactions, gained in investment banking, commodities, trading or similar.
  • At least five years’ experience in the carbon markets.
  • Experience in managing a portfolio of assets.
  • Experience in negotiating and finalising multi-million dollar contracts.
  • Familiarity in sourcing and working with lawyers.
  • Experience identifying and navigating regulatory and tax issues, particularly in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree required; master’s degree in business, economics, international development, law, or equivalent preferred.
  • Passion for the mission of Emergent.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complexity and ambiguity, and to act as an ambassador for the organisation.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and administrative skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Decisiveness and pragmatism.
  • Willingness and ability to work within a small team, ‘start-up’ and predominantly virtual environment.

Preferred experience and attributes:

  • English fluency required; Spanish, Portuguese, French or Bahasa a bonus
  • Experience working with governments, especially in low/middle-income countries.
  • Experience working with donors and/or multilateral development agencies.

Applicants must have work authorization in the US or Europe.

Emergent provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, local or other applicable laws.

Please include your cover letter and resume here as a single PDF document when applying.

Forests are crucial to all life on Earth. They capture and store carbon and are one of the most promising, large-scale, and cost-effective opportunities to combat climate change. Rainforests also sustain rainfalls, food supply, vital ecosystems, and livelihoods for over a billion people. Protecting them is not just a moral imperative, it is essential for a stable, prosperous, and sustainable future for us all. As the COVID-19 crisis highlights, we live in a fragile and interconnected world where sustainability cannot be taken for granted.

There is increasing recognition of the urgency of climate change. The Paris Agreement in 2015 committed governments to keep the increase in global average temperature to well below 2 °C above pre-industrial levels. 760 major corporations have committed to climate neutrality, and over 40 countries have implemented some form of carbon pricing scheme. After two decades of putting necessary, effective, high integrity standards and market mechanisms in place, The Emergent Forest Finance Accelerator (“Emergent”) has the historic opportunity to channel this momentum to solving the deforestation crisis.

Emergent helps safeguard the world’s tropical forests by building a global market for forest carbon credits. Countries generate these credits by reducing deforestation and tropical deforestation (called “REDD+”). For forest countries, Emergent provides a guaranteed source of demand by facilitating access to a range of high-volume buyers, backed by a purchase guarantee from donors, giving countries the certainty need-ed to make investments in forest protection and chart a new course. For buyers, Emergent provides access to the highest-quality REDD+ credits, enabling them to meet their climate neutrality goals.

In the case of corporate purchases of credits, Emergent contracts via a standard ERPA with corporate buyers on a forward, unit-contingent basis. Credits purchased from jurisdictions (also via ERPA) are sold to buyers, with the resulting revenues transferred, minus a small transaction fee, to jurisdictions via UN/World Bank-accredited ‘financial intermediaries’ (FIs). FIs will be contracted by Emergent to provide these transfer services, and to work with jurisdictions to report on the use of the funds for pre-agreed purposes.

In the case of price guarantee purchases, Emergent transfers funding from OECD governments to jurisdictions in return for credits which are then retired. (As well as providing a demand signal to jurisdictions, these transactions are effectively government-to-government ‘results-based payments’ for progress in reducing deforestation.) Before use, these funds may be held by Emergent or potentially in a trust fund arrangement administered by a multilateral such as the UN.

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer – Infrastructure & Security | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Cloud / Network / Cybersecurity Engineer to support and maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology infrastructure.

Depending on your background and specialization, this role may focus on cloud engineering, network infrastructure, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll help configure and monitor infrastructure, troubleshoot complex technical issues, manage access and authentication, support security operations, and contribute to infrastructure deployments and upgrades.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with a practical understanding of networking, cloud environments, systems, and security best practices.

What You’ll Own

Cloud & Infrastructure Management

  • Configure, monitor, and maintain cloud and infrastructure environments
  • Support platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, or related technologies
  • Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and performance
  • Assist with infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and configuration changes
  • Help maintain reliable and scalable technical environments

Network Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Configure and support network environments
  • Troubleshoot network, connectivity, DNS, routing, and infrastructure issues
  • Diagnose complex technical problems across systems and environments
  • Monitor network health and performance
  • Help maintain reliable connectivity across business systems

Cybersecurity & Security Operations

  • Implement and maintain security best practices
  • Monitor systems for potential security issues
  • Support security-related troubleshooting and incident response
  • Help identify infrastructure vulnerabilities and operational risks
  • Collaborate with relevant teams to improve the organization’s security posture

Identity & Access Management

  • Manage user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Support appropriate access controls across systems and platforms
  • Troubleshoot authentication and authorization issues
  • Help maintain secure access practices
  • Assist with onboarding, offboarding, and access changes when required

Monitoring & Incident Response

  • Monitor systems for performance, availability, and security issues
  • Investigate alerts and technical incidents
  • Support incident response and troubleshooting
  • Identify root causes and help implement corrective actions
  • Escalate critical infrastructure or security issues appropriately

Infrastructure Automation

  • Identify repetitive infrastructure tasks that can be automated
  • Build or support automation for routine technical processes
  • Improve consistency and efficiency across infrastructure workflows
  • Reduce unnecessary manual administration where possible

Documentation & Technical Operations

  • Maintain clear technical documentation
  • Document infrastructure configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures
  • Keep operational and security documentation current
  • Support repeatable processes for deployments, incidents, and system changes

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with engineering, IT, security, and business teams
  • Support technical projects and infrastructure initiatives
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to relevant stakeholders
  • Help coordinate deployments, upgrades, and operational changes

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in network engineering, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, systems administration, or a related infrastructure role
  • Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP, and/or enterprise networking technologies
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity concepts and security best practices
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical and connectivity issues
  • Understanding of user access, permissions, and authentication
  • Experience monitoring infrastructure, networks, or systems
  • Strong technical documentation skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Professional working English
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Relevant technical certifications
  • Cloud certifications related to AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Networking or cybersecurity certifications
  • Experience with infrastructure or task automation
  • Experience supporting incident response
  • Experience with identity and access management
  • Familiarity with DevOps and deployment workflows
  • Experience supporting distributed or cloud-based environments

Tools & Technologies

AWS | Microsoft Azure | Google Cloud Platform (GCP) | Enterprise Networking | Identity & Access Management | Infrastructure Monitoring | Security Tools | DevOps & Automation Technologies

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Can troubleshoot complex technical problems methodically
  • Understand how networks, systems, cloud infrastructure, and security interact
  • Think about security as part of everyday infrastructure operations
  • Stay calm and organized when responding to technical incidents
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive work
  • Maintain clear documentation rather than relying on tribal knowledge
  • Communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Take ownership of problems through resolution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include reviewing infrastructure and security alerts, troubleshooting a connectivity issue, managing user permissions, supporting a cloud deployment, or investigating a technical incident.

You may also update infrastructure configurations, automate repetitive tasks, document technical processes, and collaborate with engineering or IT teams on deployments and upgrades.

In short: you help keep the organization’s infrastructure secure, reliable, accessible, and running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Infrastructure availability and reliability
  • Network and system performance
  • Speed and effectiveness of technical issue resolution
  • Security and access-control compliance
  • Successful infrastructure deployments and upgrades
  • Effective incident response
  • Reduction in repetitive manual infrastructure work
  • Accuracy and completeness of technical documentation

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Infrastructure / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

If you have experience in cloud infrastructure, network engineering, cybersecurity, DevOps, or systems administration and enjoy solving complex infrastructure and security challenges, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing technology environments.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Operational Readiness Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Nymbus ( isn’t just a leader in fintech; we’re a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking.
jobs.description:
Nymbus ( isn’t just a leader in fintech; we’re a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.

We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work and the value we deliver to our clients. Our culture is grounded in collaboration, accountability, and a strong commitment to execution.

The journey to growth begins with doing something different, and that journey starts with the talented people who make Nymbus successful. Thank you for considering Nymbus as the catalyst for the next chapter of your career.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Occasional travel may be required for client engagements, team planning sessions, or project activities. Highly collaborative, client-facing environment with stakeholders across data, engineering, and product teams.

Working hours primarily align with the Eastern Time Zone; candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

This position is performed remotely and requires flexibility in work hours to accommodate client implementations, release cycles, testing windows, on call availability, and occasional in office work requirements.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical requirements outlined herein are indicative of those essential for an employee to effectively carry out the primary responsibilities of this position. The employee is regularly seated and frequently engages in activities such as using hands to handle, finger, or feel. Periodic standing and walking may also be necessary. Additionally, there may be occasional lifting or movement of objects weighing up to 10 pounds. Specific visual capabilities essential for this role include close vision, distance vision, and the ability to adjust focus.

INTERNET REQUIREMENTS

As a condition of employment, this role requires the candidate to maintain a stable, high speed internet connection.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Operational Readiness Analyst supports the day to day operational infrastructure of the Digital Experience Center (DXC), a multitenant contact center supporting multiple financial institution clients. Working under the direction of the Operational Readiness Manager, this role helps build, configure, test, document, and maintain the systems, forms, routing, content, and processes that DXC agents and clients rely on every day.

This is a hands-on execution role. The analyst assists with Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platform administration, IVR script maintenance, virtual agent and agent assist configuration, digital and electronic form builds, knowledge management, operational reporting, and vendor case management. The analyst also supports new client implementations by configuring the environment, building the required forms, content, and documentation, and validating that everything works before go live.

Success in this role requires someone organized, technically curious, and comfortable moving between configuration work, testing, documentation, and client facing deliverables. The work is detailed and often deadline driven, and accuracy matters because these systems directly affect how customers reach their financial institution and how agents serve them.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. CCaaS Platform Administration and Vendor Support

  • Assist with administration of the CCaaS platform, including user provisioning, role and permission assignment, security profiles, and access reviews.
  • Support configuration of skills, queues, routing rules, points of contact, hours of operation, holiday schedules, and dispositions across multiple client environments.
  • Help maintain and audit platform configuration to ensure settings remain consistent, accurate, and aligned to client requirements.
  • Assist with platform release reviews, feature evaluations, and regression testing following vendor updates.
  • Review CCaaS vendor release notes ahead of each release and identify new features, changes, and deprecations that affect DXC configuration, workflows, agent experience, or client setup.
  • Summarize release findings with recommended actions, risks, and opportunities, and provide them to the Operational Readiness Manager for review and leadership discussion.
  • Perform routine platform health checks and escalate anomalies to the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Monitor vendor service status, incident notifications, and scheduled maintenance announcements, and alert the Operational Readiness Manager and affected DXC teams to timing and expected impact.
  • Track platform incidents, degradations, and outages through resolution, documenting start and end times, affected functionality, workarounds applied, and operational impact.
  • Validate platform functionality following maintenance windows, vendor changes, and incident resolution, and report residual issues promptly.
  • Maintain a running record of incident and outage history to support trend review, vendor accountability, and service level discussions.
  • Support the intake, triage, and documentation of agent reported platform issues.
  • Open, document, and track vendor support cases with clear reproduction steps, impact statements, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor open cases through resolution, follow up on aging items, and escalate when cases stall or impact expands.
  • Maintain records of platform defects, enhancement requests, known issues, and documented workarounds.
  • Support vendor meetings by preparing agendas, capturing notes, and tracking action items to completion.
  • Assist with license, user count, and entitlement reviews for the CCaaS platform and related supported tools.
  • Maintain accurate internal documentation of platform configuration, routing logic, and operational processes so settings and decisions are traceable.
  1. IVR and Call Routing Support
  • Support IVR script development by preparing call flow requirements, documenting menu structures and routing logic, and making defined script updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with routing configuration tasks including menu options, DNIS assignments, department routing, transfer paths, and business hour logic.
  • Coordinate prompt recording requests, upload and verify audio files, and confirm prompt accuracy across client environments.
  • Test IVR changes in a development environment prior to production deployment and document test results.
  • Maintain IVR documentation, including call flow diagrams and plain language journey documentation for internal and client audiences.
  • Support reconciliation between development and production script sets by comparing configurations and flagging discrepancies for correction.
  1. Virtual Agent, Conversational AI, and Agent Assist Support
  • Support virtual agent development on the conversational AI platform (Cognigy.ai) by maintaining intents, utterances, and responses, and making defined configuration updates under the direction and review of the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Support knowledge source configuration and upkeep, including tagging, labeling, and filtering, so the virtual agent retrieves accurate, current, and approved content.
  • Structure and format operational content so it can be retrieved correctly by conversational AI and agent assist tools, and flag content that is unclear, outdated, or likely to produce poor retrieval.
  • Build and execute test utterance libraries to validate virtual agent behavior before and after changes go live.
  • Review virtual agent and agent assist outputs for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with approved processes, and escalate concerns to the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with preparation and testing of agent assist resources, including knowledge cards and suggested responses.
  • Document defects, missed intents, and containment gaps, and track them through resolution with the appropriate technical or vendor teams.
  • Assist with virtual agent updates required by product changes, policy changes, or new client onboarding.
  • Support user acceptance testing cycles and compile results for review.
  1. Digital Forms and Document Administration
  • Build, configure, test, and maintain electronic signature forms (DocuSign) and client facing web forms across financial institution clients.
  • Translate client provided form requirements into functional builds, including field logic, conditional routing, validation rules, and recipient workflows.
  • Maintain form libraries, templates, and standard data sets used across clients.
  • Test forms end to end prior to release and validate submissions route correctly to the intended destinations.
  • Troubleshoot form errors, submission failures, and routing issues reported by clients or agents.
  • Create client facing navigation guides and supporting documentation for forms and digital tools.
  1. Knowledge Content Maintenance
  • Create, update, and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, job aids, and troubleshooting guides following the content standards, formatting, and taxonomy defined by the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams and subject matter experts to gather and organize information so content is accurate, current, and usable by agents.
  • Conduct regular content reviews to identify outdated, duplicated, or incomplete documentation, and coordinate corrections with process owners.
  • Apply tagging and categorization consistently so content is findable by agents and retrievable by supported tools.
  • Move content through established review and approval workflows and track items pending approval.
  • Flag content that is unclear, conflicting, or noncompliant with organizational policies, privacy laws, or security standards for resolution.
  • Monitor changes to Nymbus platforms and supported client systems, assess downstream impact to DXC processes, and update affected knowledge content so agent guidance stays accurate after a release.
  1. New Client Implementation Support
  • Support the implementation of new financial institution clients onto the CCaaS platform.
  • Work from client requirements provided by the Operational Readiness Manager and translate them into platform configuration, routing, forms, and supporting content.
  • Build the operational assets required for launch, including electronic and web forms, knowledge content, and agent documentation, and assist with routing, IVR, and virtual agent configuration.
  • Coordinate with Project Management Operations, client services, and technical teams on internal implementation tasks, dependencies, and timelines.
  • Participate in readiness testing and validation prior to go live and document results for review.
  • Prepare client facing training materials, navigation guides, and documentation for review and delivery by the Operational Readiness Manager.
  • Assist with post launch support, issue resolution, and stabilization activities.
  1. Reporting and Data Support
  • Build, maintain, and refresh recurring operational reporting, including call volume, IVR selection and containment, virtual agent performance, form submission activity, and platform usage.
  • Produce recurring reports on an established cadence and deliver them to the Operational Readiness Manager and internal stakeholders for distribution.
  • Build and maintain reporting views, dashboards, and data extracts requested by the Operational Readiness Manager, DXC leadership, and client services.
  • Pull and prepare interaction analytics data to support reviews of contact drivers, escalation reasons, and containment performance.
  • Validate report accuracy, reconcile discrepancies between systems, and correct data quality issues at the source where possible.
  • Flag anomalies, unexpected trends, and recurring issues observed in the data to the Operational Readiness Manager for review and interpretation.
  • Support ad hoc data and reporting requests routed through the Operational Readiness Manager, leadership, and client services, including requests originating from financial institution clients.
  1. Additional Responsibilities

Perform other duties as assigned by management to contribute to the overall success and efficiency of the team and organization.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • Three or more years of experience in contact center operations, operational support, systems administration, business analysis, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • One to two years of experience in a banking, credit union, or financial services environment, with working familiarity of banking products, terminology, and customer service processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to configure, test, and troubleshoot business systems or applications.
  • Strong writing, editing, and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical processes in plain language.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities and deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and a disciplined approach to testing and validation before changes reach production.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills, including the ability to research an issue, isolate root cause, and document findings.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across operations, technology, client services, training, leadership, and vendor teams.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote, fast paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience administering a CCaaS or contact center platform, such as NICE CXone, Genesys, Five9, or Talkdesk.
  • Experience with IVR scripting, call routing configuration, or telephony administration.
  • Experience configuring or supporting conversational AI or virtual agent platforms, such as Cognigy, or similar chatbot tooling.
  • Experience building electronic signature workflows or digital forms, such as DocuSign, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with knowledge management platforms and content governance.
  • Experience reviewing interaction analytics, contact drivers, customer sentiment, or chatbot performance data.
  • Experience reviewing interaction analytics, customer sentiment, contact drivers, or chatbot and virtual agent performance.
  • Experience testing conversational AI flows, generated responses, or digital support experiences.
  • Familiarity with reporting and data tools, such as spreadsheets, dashboards, or scripting for automation.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar ticketing and documentation tools.

OUR HIRING COMMITMENTS

As an AI-first company, we embrace leveraging the power of AI tools throughout our hiring process. Nymbus remains committed to the importance of finding the right match for our teams and candidates alike. While we are excited about the AI tools at our disposal today, including the use of AI Video Interview tools, we remain committed to the human touch and oversight throughout the process.

Nymbus is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Nymbus is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process, including accommodations related to our use of AI tools. If you require an accommodation, please notify your recruiter.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the country in which the role is based- this role is currently based in the US. This role is not currently available within NYC and Illinois. Not all locations are available for consideration. Locations will be considered on a case by case basis.

In compliance with applicable pay transparency laws, this posting includes the anticipated base salary range, a general description of available benefits, and the application deadline where required. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.

SALARY & BENEFITS:

  • $55,000 - $60,000 Annual Salary
  • Annual Cash Bonus and Equity Options commensurate with the role level and experience
  • 100% Remote
  • 401(k) plan
  • Insurance - Health, Dental and Vision
  • Paid Time Off
