jobs.description:
Position Overview:

The Director of Company Operations - East Division is accountable for driving consistent, high-quality execution and business performance across all regions by enabling, coaching, and aligning Regional Directors around shared priorities, expectations, and outcomes. This role creates the leadership structure and operating discipline necessary for Regional Directors to effectively lead their markets, develop their teams, and deliver sustainable results.

Core Responsibilities:

Regional Performance Outcomes

  • Own regional performance across growth, retention, service stability, operational execution, and overall business health.
  • Maintain focus on the highest-priority business outcomes and ensure Regional Directors understand and consistently reinforce the behaviors and leading indicators that drive those results.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across regions, ensuring Regional Directors know what they own, how success is measured, and where intervention is required.
  • Identify trends, performance gaps, and emerging risks across regions and coach Regional Directors to develop and execute effective action plans.
  • Ensure sustained performance improvement by addressing root causes, reinforcing effective operating behaviors, and holding leaders accountable for follow-through and results.

Regional Director Leadership & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary leader, coach, and mentor to Regional Directors, providing the guidance, challenge, and support needed to lead their regions effectively.
  • Build leadership capability and business acumen, strengthening Regional Directors’ critical thinking, decision-making, prioritization, and ownership of key business metrics and outcomes.
  • Create consistency in leadership expectations and practices across regions while allowing Regional Directors the autonomy to lead effectively within their markets.

Execution Discipline & Operating Cadence

  • Establish and protect a clear, simple, and repeatable leadership cadence that creates consistency, visibility, and accountability across all regions.
  • Keep Regional Directors and their teams focused on the highest-impact business drivers, ensuring time and resources are directed toward the priorities and behaviors that most directly influence performance and growth.
  • Minimize organizational noise and competing priorities by helping leaders distinguish between what is urgent and what is truly important to business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Identify and resolve systemic handoff issues, friction points, and breakdowns that negatively impact the customer experience, COB experience, or business performance.
  • Partner closely with functional VPs and enterprise leaders to surface and address constraints that cannot be resolved at the regional level.
  • Bring a solutions-oriented, enterprise mindset to cross-functional challenges, focusing conversations on root causes, practical solutions, and measurable progress rather than functional ownership or blame.

Risk Identification & Escalation

  • Proactively identify early warning signs across business performance, talent, service delivery, customer experience, and operational execution before they become material issues.
  • Ensure Regional Directors develop strong risk awareness, recognizing emerging issues early and taking appropriate action within their scope of ownership.
  • Escalate material risks with clarity and urgency, providing relevant context, business impact, actions already taken, and a clear recommendation for resolution.
  • Identify patterns and systemic risks across regions, distinguishing isolated issues from broader trends that may require enterprise-level action.
  • Drive issues through resolution, maintaining appropriate visibility and accountability until material risks are mitigated or resolved.

Qualifications, Skills, & Attributes:

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive leadership experience in a service-based business environment; franchise or multi-unit operations experience strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated financial acumen with the ability to interpret profit and loss (P&L) statements, identify performance trends, and implement operational improvements to drive business results.
  • Proven ability to balance hands-on operational leadership in the field with strategic planning and executive-level communication.
  • Experience developing and presenting business strategies, operational insights, and performance recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a track record of driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent leadership and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple locations and functions.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% throughout the assigned region to company-operated branch offices, with regular travel to the corporate headquarters in Atlanta, GA.
WHO WE ARE:

Empower Brands was founded in 2022 as a product of the integration of Lynx Franchising and Outdoor Living Brands. Empower encompasses ten industry-leading brands across commercial and residential services: JAN-PRO, FRSTeam, Archadeck Outdoor Living, Outdoor Lighting Perspectives (OLP), Conserva Irrigation, Koala Insulation, Wallaby Windows, Superior Fence and Rail, Bumble Roofing and Canopy Lawn Care. Empower is dedicated to providing its customers with the highest quality products and services in the commercial and home services industry while simultaneously delivering its franchise owners committed personal support, tools and empowerment to pursue their own success. Empower Brands is a portfolio company of MidOcean Partners, a leading private equity firm with an excellent track record investing in successful, growth-focused franchise businesses. For more about Empower Brands, visit the company’s new website at .

Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Business Development Representative

Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.

Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.

Why this role exists

This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

What you’ll do

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.

Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.

Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.

Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.

Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.

Your first 90 days

We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:

First 30 days

By 60 days

By 90 days

Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.

Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.

Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

What we’re looking for

  • 2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.

  • Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.

  • Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.

  • Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.

  • Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.

  • Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.

  • Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.

If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

Position Overview

We're looking for a Conversions and Migration Associate to join our Brokerage Operations team. This role owns the operational execution of partner account conversions and migrations — a recurring, business-critical function that directly enables partner launches, account growth, and AUM movement.

You will manage the partner experience and execution of inbound assets from one clearing broker to Alpaca for our newly onboarded Broker API partners.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in broker-dealer operations with a focus on account transfers, file-based migrations, and exception resolution. You are detail-oriented, comfortable working under time pressure during conversion windows, and able to coordinate across many stakeholders while maintaining clear status reporting and documentation. This is a remote role in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

Partner Management

  • Serve as a key operational point of contact for Alpaca’s Broker API partners to facilitate and manage the inbound asset migration process
  • Project manage the asset migration lifecycle from beginning to end
  • Build strong relationships with partner firms to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and issue resolution.

Conversion & Integration Management

  • Lead onboarding and conversion of introducing brokers and RIAs from other clearing or custodial firms.
  • Coordinate operational setup, documentation, and system integration for new partner firms.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable playbooks and documentation for conversion and integration processes.
  • Partner with compliance, product, and engineering teams to identify and resolve conversion gaps or issues.
  • Reconcile migrated assets and ensure accuracy

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5 years of experience in brokerage operations, clearing, or account transfer operations.
  • Hands-on experience with account transfers (ACATS), DTC settlements, and broker-dealer back-office workflows.
  • Experience building, validating, or reconciling conversion/migration files
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with large datasets in Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to manage multiple deliverables under deadline pressure, including weekend and off-hours conversion windows.
  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to coordinate across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • FINRA SIE required; Series 7 or ability to obtain within 180 days of employment.

Preferred

  • Direct experience supporting broker-dealer or RIA conversions from other clearing or custodial firms.
  • Familiarity with ACATS lifecycle, DTC deliveries, SPOs, journals, and ledger uploads.
  • Experience with fractional shares, cost-basis/tax-lot transfers, and residual account handling.
  • Exposure to clearing firm platforms (e.g., Pershing, Apex, NFS, DriveWealth) or similar custodial environments.
  • Working knowledge of FINRA/SEC requirements related to account transfers and customer asset protection.
  • Experience coordinating with external partners and contra firms during high-volume migration events.
  • Comfort reading SQL queries or working with engineering teams on data validation (not required to write production code).

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Intakes

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. jobs.description:
BRAZIL RESIDENTS ONLY.

Company Overview

At FoodChain ID, we are driven by our vision to make it easier to keep the food supply chain safe and transparent. As a global leader in food safety, compliance, and product innovation solutions, we support more than 30,000 companies across more than 100 countries with a comprehensive software platform that enables leading food manufacturers and retailers to manage compliance, risk, and efficiently access new markets and consumers as the New Food Economy continues to evolve.

Job Title: Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead

Reports To: Director, Product and Delivery Enablement

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full Time

Job Overview

The Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead works as part of the Product Management team supporting FoodChain ID's Enterprise Solutions portfolio, which includes Formulation for PLM, Compliance Analysis, and Recipes & Specifications. The role covers the two stretches of work that sit on either side of development: getting work ready to build, and getting built work ready to deliver.

On the front end, the role develops the epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that carry an idea into a development-ready state, working day to day with the Product Management team, which sets feature scope and prioritization. Doing this well means understanding the product domain deeply enough to write requirements engineering can build from without a second round of clarification.

On the back end, the role makes sure that what development delivers is ready for customers: owning release communication, producing and maintaining product documentation, and building the training and services enablement assets that Services, Support, and Sales need to put new functionality to work. Consistent use of AI tooling is expected, including building and refining agent skills that reduce the manual effort of keeping documentation and release content current as features ship.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Definition and Development Readiness

  • Develop epics, features, and user stories from product direction, customer input, and conversations with subject matter experts (SMEs), working under the direction of the Product Management team, which owns feature scope and prioritization.
  • Author clear, testable acceptance criteria, and confirm shared understanding with engineering and QA before work is committed to a sprint.
  • Conduct the upfront research and analysis that makes story-writing and refinement sessions productive, so that decisions rest on evidence.
  • Work closely with SMEs, Services, and business partners to understand the product needs behind a request, and translate them into requirements a development team can build from.
  • Review or create process and system flow maps documenting the business domain, including the business rules and logic needed to incorporate a process into the system.
  • Identify and document story dependencies to support refinement and sequencing.
  • Maintain a regular cadence for story definition, writing, review, and refinement, keeping a backlog of sufficient depth and readiness to support team velocity.
  • Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos as the analyst closest to the requirements.

Delivery Coordination

  • Track development progress against committed plans so that commercialization work is timed to when functionality will land.
  • Raise scope changes, emerging gaps, and at-risk dates to the Product Management team early, with the specifics needed to make a decision.
  • Review delivered functionality against acceptance criteria before it is considered ready for customers, and flag discrepancies.
  • Contribute delivery and release content to the recurring account reporting and business reviews prepared by product leadership.

Release Communication

  • Own release communication end to end: build and operate a repeatable process that captures release content as it is developed.
  • Write release notes for every release, translating technical changes into language customers can act on, and publish them on a predictable cadence.
  • Brief Services, Support, and Sales ahead of customer-visible changes so that internal teams are never behind the customer.
  • Coordinate the timing of release communication with documentation and enablement updates so that customers and internal teams encounter a consistent picture.

Product Documentation

  • Own the customer documentation portal as its primary author and editor, and keep published content aligned with shipped functionality.
  • Drive documentation updates from the same source that drives release notes, so that both are produced from one pass through each release.
  • Improve the structure and quality of existing documentation over time, prioritizing the areas where support escalations and customer questions indicate confusion.
  • Establish and maintain standards for voice, structure, and depth so that content stays consistent as contributors change.

Training and Services Enablement

  • Develop the training and enablement assets that accompany newly delivered functionality, including written guides, walkthroughs, and reference material for customer and internal audiences.
  • Build the baseline materials, templates, and content standards that the Services team adapts and delivers for customer-specific training.
  • Deliver internal enablement sessions for Services, Support, and Sales as significant functionality ships.
  • Use support escalation and defect trends to identify where documentation or training gaps are generating avoidable customer friction, and close those gaps.

Implementation Templates and Standards

  • Support the implementation templatization program led by the Director, Product and Delivery Enablement, which builds the out-of-the-box configuration, data, and documentation starting point that Services and customers deploy from.
  • Own the documentation and content components of the standard package, and deliver assigned tasks within the program plan.

Launch Readiness and Adoption

  • Maintain a launch readiness standard for customer-visible functionality, confirming that documentation, training assets, internal enablement, and release communication are complete before a release reaches customers.
  • Track adoption of newly released functionality and report on it, so that the value of what we ship is visible.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • Stories and acceptance criteria reach development ready to build, with clarification cycles the exception rather than the norm.
  • Release notes publish on a predictable cadence for every release, and published documentation matches shipped functionality.
  • No significant functionality reaches customers without documentation, training assets, and internal enablement in place.
  • Services and Support are equipped to deliver customer training from materials they did not have to build themselves.
  • Adoption of newly released functionality is measured and reported on a regular cadence.

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of experience in business analysis, product management, product commercialization, or a comparable role on a software product team.
  • Two or more years as a member of an Agile team, ideally as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Scrum Master.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria that a development team built from.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders and SMEs, and translating their needs into development-ready requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing content, such as product documentation, release notes, user guides, or training material.
  • Strong written communication, with the range to write for developers, executives, and customers and adjust register accordingly.
  • Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and of Agile and Kanban practices.
  • Proficiency with development planning tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to draft, review, and maintain content.
  • Comfortable working with product usage or support data to produce straightforward adoption and quality reporting.
  • Professional, customer-facing communication style, with the poise to lead a working session or enablement session.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience authoring User Stories using Gherkin acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS products, cloud architectures, enterprise system implementations, and system integrations.
  • Background in food technology, food science, or food compliance, or familiarity with PLM or related food-industry software.
  • Experience owning product launch or commercialization readiness for a software product, including internal enablement of services or sales teams.
  • Experience building or maintaining a customer-facing documentation site or knowledge base.
  • Experience writing or configuring agent skills (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) for content maintenance or reporting.
  • Experience translating UI/UX storyboards into development stories.
  • Familiarity with product analytics or support ticket data, and comfort building straightforward reports.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Principal Product Management, Growth
jobs.excerpt: ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate.  We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life.
jobs.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

Principal Product Manager, Growth

About ZoomInfo

ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won't just contribute — you'll make things happen, fast.

The Opportunity

Own a Growth Portfolio and Set the Pattern the Rest of the Team Inherits

ZoomInfo built the industry's most sophisticated GTM data platform. The next frontier is turning every visitor into revenue without waiting on a human handoff — a coherent self-serve journey that activates a non-customer in minutes, converts consumption into upgrade, and routes high-intent signals back to sales when a human will close more than they distract.

You'll define the multi-quarter thesis on which channels compound, the operating rhythm the rest of the growth PM team inherits, and the ZoomInfo POV on how buyers discover us in an AI-first world.

The impact is immediate and compounding. Every signup you activate, every credit you cause to be consumed, every transaction, every PQL you route, every "buy more" event you trigger is revenue — and every operating pattern you set multiplies across the growth PM group. We've adopted a consumption-first monetization model and a unified entry-point thesis across the company, and we run weekly: if your hypothesis can't be falsified inside a sprint, it isn't a hypothesis. This is a rare opportunity to own a P&L-shaped surface with full air cover to ship fast, learn in public, re-pivot when the data turns — and to define the growth PM craft as ZoomInfo scales it.

What You'll Do

Own the Portfolio End-to-End

Take a portfolio-scope growth surface — and own it from first impression to revenue. Define the entry points, the activation milestones, the monetization moments, and the sales-assist signals across the channels that make up the portfolio. Drive the user experience across surfaces: landing, signup, in-product onboarding, empty states, upgrade modals, paywalls, lifecycle communication, and the agent-readable / LLM-discovery surfaces that are becoming primary. You own the funnel chart; you own the why behind every drop.

Set the Multi-Quarter Growth Thesis

Beyond weekly experiments, own 4-8 quarter bets on which channels compound and which retire. Publish a written POV on where PLG distribution is heading (LLM-first discovery, MCP-as-channel, agent-readable onboarding, partner-driven trials) and defend the sequencing to the exec team. Rebalance investment across the portfolio quarterly based on unit economics, not the loudest channel.

Run Experimentation as the Operating Rhythm — and Set the Rhythm for the Team

Ship 8-10 experiments per sprint. Pre-register the hypothesis, the metric, the success threshold, and — critically — the invalidation signal. Read results weekly, kill what doesn't work, double down on what does, and keep a written record so the team compounds learning instead of repeating it. Your rubric, your retro format, and your invalidation-signal standard become the template the rest of the Growth PM group inherits. Translate results into concrete changes: copy rewrites, schema tweaks, pricing changes, new flows, retired ones. Close the loop with engineering, design, and analytics inside the same week.

Design Self-Serve as a First-Class Path

Most users on your portfolio never speak to sales before they hit a "buy more" moment. Your in-product copy, paywall framing, empty states, activation paths, and upgrade triggers are the product. Apply growth-engineering rigor — credit economics, consumption pacing, signal routing, lifecycle messaging, intelligent gating — so the right offer lands in front of the right user at exactly the right moment. Hand high-intent users to sales with a clean signal; absorb low-intent users with a clean self-serve path.

Diagnose the Funnel With Data, Not Vibes

Data is your default tool, not a thing you ask analytics to do for you. You independently analyze the funnel, segment the cohort, find the leak, and propose the fix — then validate it with an experiment. You know when to trust a 5% lift and when to call it noise. Just as important: you know when to zoom out from a specific funnel drop to a portfolio-level rebalance, and can defend that call.

Shape the Monetization Mechanic

You'll design the credit economics of your portfolio: what's free, what's gated, what gets a "buy more" prompt, what triggers a PQL. You'll model the unit economics — credit cost, revenue per credit, upgrade rate, expansion rate — and you'll defend the pricing decisions in front of finance and sales leadership with the math.

Orchestrate Across Sales, Marketing, and CS

Self-serve doesn't mean alone. You'll route PQLs into the right hands (AE, SC, AM, or no one), partner with marketing on acquisition and lifecycle, and work with CS to understand why activated users churn before upgrade. You'll run the operating cadences that keep your portfolio aligned with the broader PLG portfolio without becoming a meeting machine.

Multiply the Team

Help hire and calibrate the Sr Growth PMs owning adjacent loops. Coach them into ownership. Your retro is their template; your experiment quality is their bar. Raise the craft of the whole Growth PM group as it scales.

Stay Honest About What's Working

Write retrospectives that name the wrong calls as cleanly as the right ones. Update your priors publicly when the data turns. Hold strong opinions weakly. The team that ships the most experiments isn't the team that's right the most — it's the team that updates the fastest.

What You'll Bring

  • 8–12 years of product management experience, with 4+ years specifically in growth, PLG, or self-serve product roles
  • Direct P&L ownership at portfolio scope — a loop or portfolio you've driven from <$X to >$Y with your name on the number, not a feature inside someone else's loop
  • Experience presenting to CEO / CRO / CFO / board on growth mechanics — the credit-economics deck, the funnel narrative, the "kill this bet" moment
  • Track record of hiring, mentoring, or calibrating other growth PMs — comfortable being the bar
  • You're a builder. You ship landing pages, signup flows, and in-product experiments — not specs that sit in Jira. You sit with designers and engineers, write copy, and prototype with code.
  • AI-fluent with a public POV. You understand that LLMs are becoming a primary discovery surface. You have opinions — publishable ones — about agent-readable flows, MCP-as-distribution, GEO/AEO, and how an AI agent's recommendation impacts a funnel.
  • Marketing-fluent. You hold your own with SEO, paid acquisition, content, and lifecycle marketing teams as a peer, not a consumer.
  • Demonstrated track record of running structured experimentation (A/B tests, multivariate, holdouts, pre/post) at sprint cadence — including at cohort sizes where 50/50 doesn't have power
  • Strong analytics fluency — comfortable in Snowflake without analyst hand-holding
  • Working knowledge of consumption-based pricing, credit economics, freemium mechanics, and PQL frameworks
  • B2B SaaS background; data, GTM, or sales-tech domain experience is a plus but not required

Who You Are

Core Competencies

Funnel Foundation. Expert-level understanding of full-funnel growth. You can reason about activation rates, time-to-value, retention curves, credit economics, upgrade triggers, and PQL signal quality with depth. You've owned a growth loop — or portfolio — in production. SQL and analytics fluency let you diagnose a funnel drop, prototype the fix, and validate it in the same week.

Portfolio Thinking. You reason about ToF (or an equivalent surface) as a portfolio of channels with different unit economics, decay curves, and compounding dynamics — not a single funnel. You rebalance investment quarterly based on where marginal dollars return the most, and you can defend the rebalance to leadership with the math.

Experimentation Discipline. You don't ship without a hypothesis. You pre-register the metric and the invalidation signal before the test runs. You read results honestly, kill losing variants without ego, and document learnings so the team compounds knowledge instead of relitigating settled questions. You know the difference between an experiment and a launch — and you can tell when each is the right move.

Category POV. You have a public, defensible point of view on where PLG distribution is heading — agent-readable surfaces, MCP-as-channel, GEO/AEO, LLM-first onboarding — grounded in benchmarks from peer companies (Clay, Linear, Vercel, Cursor, Notion), not just internal data. That POV shows up in the roadmap.

Distribution Mindset. Experience designing growth surfaces where sales teams, marketing teams, and self-serve users are simultaneously your customers. You measure success through revenue, consumption, and expansion velocity, not screens shipped. You understand growth economics: each additional entry point, freemium offer, or AI trial compounds in value through shared activation patterns, amortized acquisition costs, and recurring consumption network effects.

Operational Velocity. You read the funnel daily, not quarterly. You prototype emerging mechanics — paywalls, in-app prompts, lifecycle sequences — to understand their practical constraints before committing engineering time. You hold strong opinions weakly, updating your design assumptions as evidence accumulates, publicly, even when the prior thesis was your own.

Strategic Communication. You translate between funnel depth and business impact fluently. You can explain to the CEO why a credit pricing change is worth a quarter of work. You can communicate to engineers why a revenue constraint requires a "quiet release" in two weeks rather than a polished launch in three months. You influence without formal authority through forcing functions, falsifiable invalidation signals, and earned credibility.

Talent Leverage. You coach Sr PMs into full ownership of their loops. Your retro is their template. Your experiment quality is their bar. You help hire the next PMs on the team, and you calibrate — you know what "great" looks like at Sr level and you can articulate the gap to someone who isn't there yet.

Copy Instinct. Microcopy is part of your craft, not someone else's job. You can rewrite a paywall headline, an upgrade modal, an empty state, or an onboarding CTA on instinct — and defend the rewrite with PLG principles. You know when to ask content design for help and when to ship the rewrite yourself.

The Environment

Reporting, Pace & Impact

Reporting & Collaboration. Report to the VP Product, PLG. Peer to the Sr Directors of Marketing, Sales Operations, and Customer Success on the growth contracts (PQL routing, demand-gen alignment, credit economics). Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the engineering and design leaders building the underlying surfaces, the GTM leaders routing PQLs into sales, and a peer PM group covering monetization, lifecycle, viral, onboarding, and analytics. Regular exposure to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and CFO — you own those conversations at your level.

Pace & Problems. Fast-moving teams that understand the space. Weekly experimentation cadence layered under 4-quarter portfolio bets. Expect interesting problems: How do we win activation in a user's first 60 seconds? When should two trial flows become one? How do we expose enough value to convert without giving away the platform? How do we price a credit so that customers consume more, not less? When should a self-serve user be routed to sales — and when does that routing actually destroy revenue? How do buyers discover ZoomInfo when discovery goes through Claude and ChatGPT? Your decisions become operating patterns across the PLG organization.

Impact. Own a portfolio-scope growth surface at a company that is already AI-first in product thinking and consumption-first in monetization. Your decisions compound. Every improvement to the funnel, the offer, or the activation experience multiplies across multiple products, every partner-driven self-serve channel ZoomInfo ships into, and every AI distribution surface we haven't yet imagined — and every operating pattern you set makes the next PM on the team better.

What changed at a glance:

  • Title + opening reframed from loop-scope → portfolio-scope, ToF-leaning but flexible
  • Three new sections in What You'll Do: Set the Multi-Quarter Thesis, Represent PLG to Leadership, Multiply the Team
  • Seniority bar: 4-7 yrs → 8-12 yrs; adds direct P&L ownership, exec/board presenting, hiring/mentoring
  • Two new competencies: Portfolio Thinking, Category POV, Talent Leverage
  • Reporting line: Sr Director → VP Product, PLG; peer to CRO/CMO/CFO direct reports

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

  1. Online assessment or practical task

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to build, scale, and maintain modern web applications and cloud infrastructure across high-impact product environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can own features end-to-end — from front-end user experience to back-end architecture, APIs, databases, deployments, and infrastructure reliability.

You’ll work closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ship scalable applications that are performant, secure, and built for long-term growth.

This role goes beyond simply writing code. You’ll contribute to technical architecture, improve engineering processes, mentor junior developers, and help shape the reliability and scalability of the platform as the company grows.

If you enjoy building production-grade systems, solving infrastructure challenges, and shipping features quickly without compromising quality, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack Product Development

  • Build and maintain scalable web applications using React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue
    • Develop secure and performant back-end services using Node.js, Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), or similar frameworks

Infrastructure, DevOps & Cloud Deployment

Testing, Reliability & Security

    • Implement secure authentication, authorization, and API best practices

    • Troubleshoot outages, performance bottlenecks, and production issues proactively

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Participate in architecture reviews and technical planning discussions
    • Review pull requests and mentor junior engineers through code feedback and collaboration
    • Work closely with product managers and designers to refine requirements and technical feasibility
    • Help improve engineering workflows, standards, and development processes

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You can independently ship features from concept to deployment
    • You understand both application development and infrastructure reliability
    • You balance speed, scalability, and code quality effectively
    • You enjoy solving complex technical problems in production environments
    • You communicate clearly and collaborate well across teams

Required Experience & Skills

    • Strong debugging, optimization, and problem-solving skills

    • Familiarity with microservices and event-driven systems
    • Experience monitoring production systems using Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or similar tools

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A Senior Full Stack Engineer’s day revolves around building features, improving infrastructure, and maintaining system reliability. You will:

In short: you are responsible for building reliable, scalable, and production-ready software systems that directly support business growth.

jobs.description:
Request for Proposals: Registered Apprenticeship Program Services

Issued by: Healthcare Career Advancement Program (H-CAP)

The Healthcare Career Advancement Program (H-CAP) invites qualified consultants, organizations, and firms to submit proposals to provide program management services supporting H-CAP’s Registered Apprenticeship program.

H-CAP will be accepting RFPs for a consultant to support its Registered Apprenticeship Work. The consultant can work up to 35 hours per week. The hourly rate is $158/hour.

The selected contractor(s) will develop, implement, and strengthen registered apprenticeship programs in healthcare in partnership with labor-management organizations, unions, employers, education providers, workforce boards, and other stakeholders.

1. Background

The Healthcare Career Advancement Program (H-CAP) is a national labor/management organization that promotes innovation and quality in healthcare career education. Our mission is to transform healthcare workforce development and to support highly-trained, highly-valued professionals to better meet the need for quality care in a rapidly changing industry. We are committed to fostering value in healthcare careers, and to helping employers recruit and retain the best-trained professionals, to meet their needs and the needs of our communities.

H-CAP works with employers, unions, and workers to deploy high-quality training to support the healthcare industry at a time of unprecedented system transformation. These training programs seek to lift up workers, create a pipeline of well-trained staff for employers, and ensure that healthcare continues to fulfill its promise as a primary engine of the economy, both nationally and locally.

Through this RFP, H-CAP seeks a contractor to support its Registered Apprenticeship portfolio, including healthcare-based outreach and recruitment, program development, implementation support, stakeholder engagement, materials development, and related educational activities.

2. Contractor Responsibilities

The contractor will be expected to work closely with H-CAP’s Registered Apprenticeship team, H-CAP leadership, labor-management partners, and affiliated organizations. Work will primarily be conducted remotely, with travel to program sites or national events as needed.

3. Required Services and Deliverables

Partner Education

  • Conduct informational sessions in a variety of formats for various stakeholders.
  • Plan and implement not less than (5) meetings of 10 or more stakeholders who want to learn more about Registered Apprenticeship Programs

Program Development

  • Recruit not less than 25 employers who want to begin new registered apprenticeship programs or expand upon existing programs.
  • Provide support including identifying apprenticeable occupations, creating standards, and working to get standards approved, and
  • Support he creation of multi-employer apprenticeship programs

Communications and Marketing Support

  • Support the creation of materials that support Registered Apprenticeship outreach.
  • Work with H-CAP’s Data and Communications team to amplify Registered Apprenticeship promotional and marketing efforts as directed by H-CAP leadership.

Grant Compliance, Tracking, and Reporting

  • Track deliverables to ensure compliance with grant and contract obligations.
  • Enter accurate and timely data into a variety of tracking systems.
  • Gather data and write reports on progress.

4. Preferred Qualifications and Experience

Industry Contacts and Background

  • Possess deep knowledge and experience working with healthcare employers and stakeholders on workforce development issues
  • Ability to reach out to healthcare care consortia, certifying bodies, industry associations, etc. and connect with them on the need for creating Registered Apprenticeship Programs
  • Knowledge of the healthcare industry and workforce development.
  • Knowledge of Registered Apprenticeship and the Registered Apprenticeship System.
  • Experience with post-secondary education and adult education programs.

Project Management and Coordination

  • A minimum of 5 years of project management experience.
  • Excellent project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Communication and Presentation

  • Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
  • Ability and comfort presenting to a variety of audiences using a mix of methods, including virtual and in-person formats.

Labor-Management and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work experience or familiarity with union or labor-management environments.
  • Existing connections with stakeholders such as healthcare employers, industry associations, unions, labor-management organizations, workforce boards, and education partners.

5. Proposal Requirements

Proposals should include: (1) a cover letter; (2) a resume with description of the proposer’s qualifications and relevant experience; (3) a summary of how the proposer will identify and recruit employers and stakeholders who will commit to starting registered apprenticeship programs; including the amount of hours per week the proposer is able to commit to the project, and (4) references from comparable projects or clients if requested.

6. Evaluation Criteria

H-CAP will evaluate proposals based on demonstrated experience with Registered Apprenticeship, healthcare workforce development, labor-management partnerships, project management capacity, quality of proposed approach, ability to meet deliverables, cost reasonableness, and references.

7. Anticipated Timeline

H-CAP anticipates selecting a contractor following review of submitted proposals and may invite finalists for interviews. H-CAP will accept proposals through September 30, 2026. H-CAP will then review each RFP and selection should be completed by November 15, 2026.

8. Submission Instructions

Proposals should be submitted electronically through the H-CAP Hiring Portal.

Salary: $158/hour

Interacts with regulatory agencies regarding product registrations, licensures, and permits and supports regulatory compliance to QSR, ISO, CMDR, MDSAP, IVDD/IVDR, CFR and other worldwide regulatory requirements.   • Carries out duties in compliance with established business policies.

  • Perform other duties & projects as assigned.

The Individual

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in a scientific discipline

  • Minimum of 12 years prior experience in the IVD (in vitro diagnostic), medical device or bio/pharma industry manufacturing environment

  • Minimum of 12 years prior experience in Regulatory Affairs (or related educational/work experience) with progression of responsibility and leadership

  • Must possess a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Ability to support Clinical, R&D, V&V, and PMO departments on an as needed basis in order to meet corporate objectives

  • Ability to work independently and be self-motivated

  • Ability to work under minimal supervision following established procedures

  • Ability to handle inter/intradepartmental issues in a cooperative and diplomatic manner

  • Ability to work on assignments of high visibility where independent action and a high degree of initiative is needed in resolving problems and developing recommendations

  • Ability to exercise judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio,

  • This position is not currently eligible for visa sponsorship.

Preferred:

Interact with cross functional partners to manage registration activities and mentors RA colleagues in their professional growth. Supervises interactions with local, state and federal agencies in securing marketing clearances, licenses and permits (e.g., FDA, CDC, USDA-APHIS, etc.). Senior Accountant – NetSuite Pro | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Accountant – NetSuite Pro to own day-to-day accounting operations across multiple entities, including real estate development projects, operating companies, and personal investment structures.

This is a high-trust, execution-heavy accounting role for someone who is deeply hands-on with NetSuite and can independently maintain clean books, complete reconciliations, execute close cycles, and produce reliable financial reporting.

You’ll work closely with leadership, the VP of Asset Management, a Fractional CFO, and external accounting partners to maintain financial accuracy across a complex multi-entity environment.

This is not a supervisory or theory-focused role. You’ll be expected to do the accounting work directly, accurately, and consistently with minimal hand-holding.

What You’ll Own

Core Accounting & Close Execution

  • Prepare and maintain accurate general ledger records
  • Complete bank and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Prepare recurring and adjusting journal entries
  • Own month-end and year-end close processes
  • Generate and review:
    • Balance sheets
    • Income statements
    • Entity-level P&Ls
    • Supporting financial schedules
  • Investigate discrepancies and resolve accounting issues promptly
  • Ensure financial records remain complete, accurate, and current

Multi-Entity Accounting

  • Manage accounting across multiple legal entities and financial structures
  • Support:
    • Development projects
    • Operating companies
    • Personal investment structures and assets
  • Maintain proper separation and alignment between company and personal financial activity
  • Ensure transactions are recorded within the correct entities
  • Support accounting setup and execution for future ventures and entities as the portfolio expands

Real Estate & Project-Level Accounting

  • Track expenses across individual real estate development projects
  • Maintain property-level P&Ls for each development
  • Ensure project costs are properly categorized and reconciled
  • Maintain clear financial visibility across projects and entities
  • Support financial reporting related to new real estate developments and investments

NetSuite – Critical

  • Work hands-on in NetSuite every day
  • Manage transaction entry, imports, reconciliations, and financial data
  • Maintain accurate general ledger activity within NetSuite
  • Troubleshoot discrepancies and data issues
  • Ensure disciplined and consistent system usage
  • Maintain clean financial records that leadership and external accounting partners can rely on

This role requires genuine hands-on NetSuite experience. General ERP familiarity without substantial day-to-day NetSuite usage will not be sufficient.

Compliance, Controls & External Accounting

  • Maintain accounting practices aligned with GAAP and internal controls
  • Prepare supporting documentation for tax and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with external accounting partners, including Baker Tilly
  • Support quarterly tax calls and financial reviews
  • Assist with cost segregation and related accounting requirements
  • Prepare accurate documentation for tax filings and external review
  • Respond to accounting requests with organized supporting information

Financial Reporting & Leadership Support

  • Support the VP of Asset Management and Fractional CFO
  • Prepare accurate financial data and reporting for leadership
  • Provide clear explanations for account activity and discrepancies
  • Ensure decision-makers have reliable financial information
  • Maintain transparency across financial records and reporting

Systems & Data Management

  • Maintain accurate financial workflows across:
    • NetSuite
    • AppFolio
    • Excel
    • Gmail
    • ClickUp
  • Work with AppFolio across investor and property management functions as needed
  • Maintain organized accounting documentation and supporting records
  • Ensure financial information remains consistent across systems

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • Strong, hands-on NetSuite accounting experience
  • Experience using NetSuite for:
    • General ledger activity
    • Imports
    • Journal entries
    • Reconciliations
    • Financial reporting
    • Close processes
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • Experience working with large financial datasets and complex reconciliations
  • Strong understanding of general ledger accounting
  • Proven experience preparing:
    • Balance sheets
    • Income statements
    • P&Ls
    • Account reconciliations
  • Experience with month-end and year-end close
  • Strong understanding of GAAP
  • Exceptional attention to detail and financial accuracy
  • Ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently
  • Strong written and verbal English communication
  • Ability to operate with minimal supervision
  • Comfortable taking direct ownership and accountability for financial work
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-entity accounting
  • Real estate development or property accounting experience
  • Experience maintaining project-level or property-level P&Ls
  • Experience with AppFolio
  • Experience supporting investment entities or personal investment structures
  • Experience working alongside Fractional CFOs or asset management teams
  • Experience coordinating with external accounting or tax firms
  • Familiarity with cost segregation
  • Experience with ClickUp or similar project management platforms

Tools & Tech

NetSuite | Microsoft Excel | AppFolio | ClickUp | Gmail | Accounting & Financial Reporting Systems

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re genuinely hands-on with accounting and enjoy doing the work
  • You know NetSuite deeply enough to operate independently
  • You’re meticulous about reconciliations and clean books
  • You can manage accounting across multiple entities without losing accuracy
  • You investigate discrepancies instead of simply flagging them
  • You understand that small accounting errors can create larger downstream problems
  • You communicate financial information clearly and honestly
  • You self-correct and solve problems without requiring constant oversight
  • You value precision, consistency, and disciplined execution

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by reviewing transactions and completing reconciliations in NetSuite, then investigate discrepancies across several entities or development projects.

From there, you might process journal entries, import financial data, update property-level P&Ls, prepare month-end schedules, work through requests from the Fractional CFO, or gather documentation for an external accounting review.

Throughout the day, you’ll ensure every entity’s books remain accurate, reconciled, and ready for reliable reporting.

In short: you own the accounting execution that keeps a complex multi-entity financial environment clean and trustworthy.

Accounting Environment

This role is execution-focused and systems-driven.

You’ll be supported by established accounting frameworks, recurring close cycles, leadership, and external accounting partners.

Your ownership centers around:

Accuracy | Reconciliation | Clean Books | Reliable Reporting | Financial Transparency

Key Metrics for Success

  • Clean and accurate financials across all entities
  • Minimal accounting errors and rework
  • On-time month-end and year-end closes
  • Accurate balance sheet and P&L reporting

  4. Practical Accounting or NetSuite-Based Exercise
  5. Final Interview
  6. Internal Review & Approval
  7. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re a Senior Accountant with deep hands-on NetSuite experience who excels at reconciliations, multi-entity accounting, financial reporting, and maintaining clean books, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is ideal for someone who wants real ownership and is confident independently executing the accounting work that leadership relies on.

ABOUT VIVID SOLUTIONS

Vivid Solutions is an innovative software development company dedicated to providing user-centred and cutting-edge technology solutions for our clients in the BC Government sector. We thrive on tackling complex problems, and are passionate about helping people and businesses thrive by developing technology solutions that enable them to excel in their respective industries. We offer a unique work experience that balances making a tangible impact with the continuous growth and stability that you seek, while our people-first culture fosters professional development and work-life balance. We are headquartered in Victoria, BC and to learn more about what we offer please visit

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-oriented and versatile Proposal Writer to join Vivid Solutions on a contract, as-needed basis. Working closely with our executive team and subject matter experts, you will lead the development of high-quality responses to RFPs, bids, and other competitive opportunities, across public and private sectors.

This is an on-call engagement, as opportunities arise, well suited to someone who can work independently, flex their availability around submission deadlines, and hit the ground running. Beyond individual submissions, you will also play a role in strengthening Vivid’s proposal function more broadly, helping us maintain the tools, templates and source material that support consistent, high-quality proposals over time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Proposal Development: Review solicitation documents (RFPs, RFQs, and similar) to identify requirements, evaluation criteria, and submission risks; write clear, compelling proposal content that directly addresses scoring matrices.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Interview subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to gather technical, operational, and business information, asking thoughtful questions to uncover what isn’t immediately apparent.
  • Content Synthesis: Translate complex, technical concepts into clear, persuasive written responses tailored to evaluator expectations.
  • Proposal Process & Materials: Maintain and continuously improve Vivid’s proposal resources and workflow, including source material, templates, and review processes.
  • Quality & Compliance: Identify information gaps, coordinate with internal teams to close them, and ensure submissions meet formatting, compliance, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Responsible AI Use: Use AI tools appropriately to support research, organization, and drafting, applying strong editorial judgment and sound discretion regarding what information can be entered into AI/LLM tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven experience in proposal writing, grant writing, or government procurement responses, public sector experience is required.
  • Direct experience with public-sector procurement processes, government funding programs, and writing against scoring matrices.
  • Experience working with technical subject matter experts, including conducting interviews and extracting information from stakeholders.
  • Strong ability to turn incomplete or ambiguous information into clear, well-structured written content.
  • Comfort with technology and technical conversations, you don’t need to be technical yourself, but should be at ease working alongside a technical team.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage and evolve proposal templates, tracking tools, and process documentation.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with flexibility to accommodate occasional “all hands-on deck” submission pushes.
  • Experience in a related field such as management consulting, public policy, research, technical communications, or academic writing (Master’s or PhD) is an asset.

YOU WILL…

  • Be an exceptional listener, identifying what’s missing, asking the right follow-up questions, and uncovering what evaluators need to see.
  • Bring strong editorial judgment and a keen eye for detail to everything you write.
  • Take ownership of Vivid’s proposal process, proactively improving our tools and templates over time.
  • Thrive under deadline pressure while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Use strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with our team, whether remote or in person.
  • Believe in providing the best experience to our clients and team.

CONTRACT DETAILS

  • Independent contractor, on-call / as-needed basis, with work volume tied to active pursuits.
  • Hourly Rate: $40-$60/hour, depending on experience, expertise, and the nature of the work assigned.
  • Remote BC work; availability during standard business hours (9–5 PST) is preferred to support collaboration, with flexibility required around submission deadlines.
  • Bonus consideration for proposals and submissions that result in contract awards.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

We are an equal-opportunity employer and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for employees from all walks of life. Hiring decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or disability. We hire based on talent, and we’re excited to hear what you will bring to our team!

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please submit a resume and cover letter, along with a writing sample if available. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

If you don’t meet all of our requirements exactly or have taken a non-traditional professional path, we still want to hear from you! Use your cover letter to tell us about your unique experience, we strive to build a diverse team and recognize that skills are transferable.

Salary: $40-$60 / hour

FormFactor, Inc.
